jobs.title: Patient Experience Coordinator / Lead Chiropractic Assistant
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a warm, organized, high\-ownership Patient Experience Coordinator / Lead Chiropractic Assistant to help create an exceptional patient experience while keeping the front end of our practice running smoothly.

This role is highly patient\-facing and directly impacts the health of the practice.

You will help manage the patient journey from the first phone call through active care, making sure leads are followed up with, schedules stay full, patients feel cared for, and important details do not fall through the cracks.

We are looking for someone who is naturally outgoing and personable, but also organized, proactive, and dependable.

As the practice grows, there is opportunity to take on more responsibility in systems, operations, and team leadership.

**What You’ll Own**

* Greet patients and create a warm, welcoming experience
* Check patients in and keep clinic flow organized
* Answer phone calls and respond to patient texts
* Schedule appointments and care plans
* Collect payments and help maintain accurate accounts
* Follow up with new leads quickly and consistently
* Help convert inquiries into scheduled new\-patient appointments
* Manage confirmations, cancellations, no\-shows, and rescheduling
* Keep patients prebooked and engaged in their care
* Follow up with patients who fall off schedule
* Run reactivation lists and outreach
* Support CMR scheduling and coordination
* Help coordinate clinic events and patient campaigns
* All scans from start to finish
* Preparing patients for scans
* Making sure scans are completed on time
* Making sure scan results are organized and ready for you
* Tracking who is due for a scan or rescan
* Maintain accurate patient information and front\-desk systems
* Notice problems, communicate them early, and help create solutions
* Help improve front\-desk processes as the practice grows

**What Success Looks Like**

You are doing well in this role when:

* Patients feel known, welcomed, and cared for
* Leads are followed up with consistently
* New patients get scheduled quickly
* The schedule is organized and well managed
* Cancellations and no\-shows are followed up on
* Patients stay engaged throughout their care
* Payments and communication are handled accurately
* Fewer opportunities are lost because someone forgot to follow up
* The front desk feels calm, organized, and proactive
* You can be trusted to own your responsibilities without being chased

**You’ll Be a Great Fit If You**

* Are naturally warm, friendly, and confident with people
* Have strong communication skills
* Are extremely organized
* Follow through without needing repeated reminders
* Can handle multiple priorities without becoming scattered
* Take ownership when something needs attention
* Notice details other people may miss
* Are comfortable making phone calls and following up with leads
* Enjoy helping people and building relationships
* Can receive feedback without becoming defensive
* Are willing to learn numbers and understand how your role impacts the practice
* Want to grow with a company rather than simply clock in and out

Experience in chiropractic, healthcare, hospitality, customer service, sales, or a busy front\-office environment is helpful, but attitude, ownership, and follow\-through matter most.

**This Role Probably Isn’t For You If**

* You dislike being on the phone
* Following up with leads feels uncomfortable to you
* You need someone to constantly remind you what to do
* You prefer waiting for instructions instead of taking initiative
* You struggle with organization or details
* You avoid direct feedback
* You become easily overwhelmed when several things happen at once
* You want a quiet administrative role with limited interaction
* You believe front desk means simply answering phones and checking people in

**Our Core Values**

This role lives these values in front of every family and every team member, every day.

Better People

We hire people we would fight to keep.

Character comes first. We take ownership, communicate directly, and make the person next to us better.

Earned Greatness

You bring your best when the day gets hard.

You do not wait for things to improve on their own. You get incrementally better on purpose and take pride in leaving the practice stronger than you found it.

Contagious Calm

Families borrow the nervous system of the room.

You are that room.

You stay present, organized, and confident even when the practice is busy.

**Growth Opportunity**

This role begins primarily focused on patient experience and front\-desk ownership.

As the practice grows, there is opportunity to expand into areas such as:

* Practice Manager
* Front\-desk leadership
* Training future team members
* KPI tracking
* Systems and process improvement
* Events and campaigns
* Practice operations

Growth in responsibility comes through ownership, results, consistency, and trust.

How to Apply

Please email your resume and answer the following question to drdanika@fikachiropractic.com. Only applications sent via email will be considered.

**If you ran the front desk at Fika, what's one thing you'd do in your first 30 days to improve how families experience our office?**

Pay: $24\.00 \- $27\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 28\.0 – 35\.0 per week

Work Location: In person

Licensed Pharmacy Technician – Patient Care Coordinator (PCC)  


Full\-Time \& Part\-Time Opportunities \| Oakland, CA  


A clear and active California Pharmacy Technician license is required. Applicants without an active license cannot be considered.  


Be Part of Our Growing Northern California Team  


Since 1989, MDR Pharmacy has helped patients across the nation on their journey to parenthood. What started as a small, family\-run pharmacy in Los Angeles has grown into one of the largest independently owned specialty fertility pharmacies in the U.S.  


MDR opened its first Northern California location in Oakland earlier this year. This is an opportunity to join a growing team, support the continued development of our Oakland operations, and build a long\-term career in specialty pharmacy.  


About the Role  


The Patient Care Coordinator (PCC) is at the heart of our patient experience team. This position operates in a fast\-paced call center setting and serves as a point of contact for IVF clinics and patients. You’ll help ensure patients receive their fertility medications accurately, on time, and with compassion.  


This role is a great opportunity for a licensed Pharmacy Technician who is:  


· Reliable and comfortable in a busy, high\-energy environment  


· Adaptable and ready to learn  


· Empathetic and passionate about helping others  


· Able to remain calm and professional during sensitive patient interactions  


What You’ll Do  


· Process prescriptions and accurately enter patient, medication, insurance, billing, and delivery information under a pharmacist’s supervision.  


· Coordinate with patients and IVF clinics to ensure medication orders are accurate and delivered on time.  


· Assist with insurance, billing, refill, and order issues, escalating clinical questions to the pharmacist when needed.  


· Communicate with empathy and professionalism while protecting patient confidentiality.  


· Collaborate with pharmacists, technicians, shipping, billing, and other departments to resolve issues efficiently.  


· Manage multiple priorities using strong attention to detail, organization, and basic math skills.  


What We’re Looking For

As part of your training, you will rotate through several departments at our Los Angeles headquarters, including the Front Pharmacy Clerk, Operators, and Shipping departments, before being paired with a Lead Patient Care Coordinator. You will receive continuous guidance, feedback, and support as you grow into the Patient Care Coordinator role and contribute to MDR’s growing Northern California team.

· Medical, dental, and vision benefits  


· 401(k)  


· Paid vacation and holidays  


Pay: Up to $30\.00 per hour

Description:
**Title:** Site Safety and Operations Coordinator  

**Organization:** Boys and Girls Clubs of San Leandro  

**Location:** School–based Site  

**Department:** Programming

**Reports to:** Program Manager

**Direct Reports:** None  

**Exempt Status:** Non\-Exempt

**Position Type:** Full\-Time, On\-Site

**Compensation:** $23\-$30/hr

**Position Overview:**


The Site Safety \& Operations Coordinator (SSOC) is a key leader in fostering a safe, structured, and welcoming after\-school environment for youth and staff. This role ensures smooth daily operations by overseeing safety protocols, managing site logistics, and supporting staff in upholding the highest standards of care. Through proactive training, incident response, and collaboration with school and organizational leadership, the SSOC plays a vital role in creating an environment where students can learn and thrive.


This position is central to the BGCSL’s mission by ensuring that safety and operational excellence are seamlessly integrated into the program. By maintaining compliance, training staff in emergency procedures, and strengthening site security, the SSOC helps sustain a program where students feel secure and supported, allowing them to fully engage in enriching after\-school experiences.


What makes this role unique is its dynamic blend of safety leadership, hands\-on operational management, and staff development. The SSOC not only ensures compliance and emergency readiness but also plays a key role in coaching staff and fostering a culture of safety. This is a role for a proactive, solutions\-oriented individual who thrives in a fast\-paced environment and is passionate about creating a safe and structured space for youth development.

**Our Values in Action:**

**Transformative Leadership:** We aspire to transform possibilities into probabilities. By embodying emotional intelligence, vulnerability, and empathy, we foster positive change with humility, authenticity, and continuous self\-improvement.

* ***What that looks like in this role:*** Leading with empathy and authenticity, creating a safe, supportive, and collaborative environment for staff and youth. Empowering and mentoring YDPs, providing strong onboarding, training, and ongoing development. Continuously improving safety and operations, approaching challenges with adaptability and a solutions\-focused mindset.

**Resilience:** We approach every situation with a growth mindset, demonstrating flexibility and courage, reframing challenges as opportunities. We acknowledge our current state, embrace change, and adapt as needed, maintaining a solutions\-oriented approach throughout our growth journey.

* ***What that looks like in this role:*** Leading with adaptability and a growth mindset, turning challenges into opportunities for improvement. Staying solutions\-focused and flexible, adjusting to changing needs while ensuring safety and efficiency. Maintaining confidence and composure under pressure, guiding the team through unexpected situations.

**Youth Centered Approach:** Every organizational action or maneuver is designed to directly impact and benefit the youth we serve. We value and prioritize the youth perspective, making decisions with a focus on their needs and well\-being, rather than adult convenience.

* ***What that looks like in this role:***Prioritizing the safety, well\-being, and experience of youth, ensuring all operations support their growth and success. Making decisions with a youth\-first mindset, creating a safe, engaging, and supportive after\-school environment. Advocating for youth needs, collaborating with staff to implement policies and practices that benefit them directly.

**Essential Functions:**

* **Daily Operations \& Compliance**: Oversee daily site operations, ensuring adherence to BGCSL, School Site, and District policies while maintaining a structured and efficient environment.
* **Safety Protocols \& Emergency Preparedness**: Implement and lead safety procedures, conduct regular drills, and work closely with the Director of Club Safety and Operations to align on best practices.
* **Incident Management \& Reporting**: Investigate, document, and implement corrective actions for safety incidents while ensuring compliance with safety standards through monthly inspections.
* **Staff Training \& Development**: Lead onboarding, ongoing training, and certification programs for staff in collaboration with Learning \& Development and HR, ensuring CPR and first aid compliance.
* **Student \& Facility Oversight**: Manage student enrollment, class assignments, and check\-in/out processes through MyClubHub while ensuring a safe, organized, and functional site environment.
* **Regulatory Compliance \& Documentation**: Maintain accurate safety records, incident reports, and compliance documentation while coordinating with school administration for facility access and resources.
* **Collaboration \& Communication**: Provide regular updates to leadership on safety improvements and operational needs while partnering with district safety teams to align protocols and best practices.
* **Culture of Safety \& Teamwork**: Foster a proactive, safety\-focused environment where all staff are engaged in maintaining security, order, and student well\-being.

* Experience: At least two years of experience working with school\-aged youth in an educational or after\-school setting (excluding daycare environments).
* Certifications: Current First Aid and CPR certification or willingness to obtain before the start date.
* Commitment: Availability for the entire academic school year, including training sessions and after\-school closeout operations.

jobs.title: Customer Care Specialist
jobs.description:
1\.0 FTE Full time Day \- 08 Hour R2660260 Onsite 108610019 Admin Cancer Center Sutter Joint Venture Other Oakland, 3023 Summit St, California
If you're ready to be part of our legacy of hope and innovation, we encourage you to take the first step and explore our current job openings. Your best is waiting to be discovered.

  


Day \- 08 Hour (United States of America)**This is a Stanford Health Care job.**  

  

**A Brief Overview**  

The Customer Care Specialist is responsible for ensuring excellent service values, responds efficiently to patients, families, and staff members and maintains high C\-I\-CARE standards at Stanford Health Care Gift Shops.  

  

Customer Care Specialists also assist in recommending inventory to carry, upselling and merchandising of inventory, helping leadership create an asthetic environment for customers, and most importantly enhancing the Patient Experience for patients and families while in the hospital.  

  

The Customer Care Specialist reports directly to the Assistant Manager/Manager.  

  

**Locations**  

Stanford Health Care  

  

**What you will do**

* Sell merchandise; operate Point of Sale (POS) system; receive cash; make change; quote prices; process and handle credit card sales; record all sales in POS, receive payment for sales and issue correct change, open and close cash register daily.
* Assist customers in locating and purchasing various retail items, including suggesting selection to customer by emphasizing quality, style or utility of articles.
* Ensures daily shipments are received properly, inspected and tagged before merchandising in retail locations.
* Fulfills daily inventory requests and transfers stock to multiple retail locations.
* Maintain overall shop appearance, replenish, organize and maintain inventory.
* Provide merchandising ideas/recommendations to Retail Coordinator.
* Closely manage inventory for specific assigned zones and departments; start to finish\- buying, stocking, organizing, selling, and inventory count accuracy.
* Conducts accurate cycle counts as per schedule and compares results to system data. Works with coordinator to make adjustments based on established policies and management approval.
* Participate in physical inventories; prepare and maintain inventory records; assist in receiving stock.
* Clean shelves, fixtures, and furnishings.

 **Education Qualifications**

* High School Diploma or GED equivalent

 **Experience Qualifications**

* Two (2\) years of retail experience working in a high\-end, fast\-past environment

 **Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

* Ability to multi\-task, adapt to and deal with change and ambiguity
* Ability to plan, organize, prioritize, work independently, manage time effectively and meet deadlines
* Ability to solve problems and identify solutions
* Ability to pay attention to details
* Customer service orientation with a positive attitude; friendly and pleasant demeanor over the phone and in person
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced work environment
* Ability to read, write and effectively listen and communicate in English with all types of individuals, including patients, family members, colleagues, dignitaries and executive leaders; ability to adapt/respond to different types of personalities, situations and emotions
* Ability to work a variety of hours, including early mornings, evenings, weekends and holidays.
* Ability to work as part of a team and take initiative independent of direct supervision
* Knowledge of computer systems and Point of Sale software used in functional area
* Knowledge of local, state and federal regulatory requirements related to areas of functional responsibility

 **Licenses and Certifications**

* None

 **These principles apply to ALL employees:**  

  

**SHC Commitment to Providing an Exceptional Patient \& Family Experience**  

  

*Stanford Health Care sets a high standard for delivering value and an exceptional experience for our patients and families. Candidates for employment and existing employees must adopt and execute C\-I\-CARE standards for all of patients, families and towards each other. C\-I\-CARE is the foundation of Stanford’s patient\-experience and represents a framework for patient\-centered interactions. Simply put, we do what it takes to enable and empower patients and families to focus on health, healing and recovery.*  

  

*You will do this by executing against our three experience pillars, from the patient and family’s perspective:*

* Know Me: Anticipate my needs and status to deliver effective care
* Show Me the Way: Guide and prompt my actions to arrive at better outcomes and better health
* Coordinate for Me: Own the complexity of my care through coordination

**Equal Opportunity Employer Stanford Health Care (SHC) strongly values diversity and is committed to equal opportunity and non\-discrimination in****all of****its policies and practices, including the area of employment. Accordingly, SHC does not discriminate against any person on the basis of race, color, sex, sexual orientation or gender identity and/or expression, religion, age, national or ethnic origin, political beliefs, marital status, medical condition, genetic information, veteran status, or disability, or the perception of any of the above. People of all genders, members of all racial and ethnic groups, people with disabilities, and veterans are encouraged to apply. Qualified applicants with criminal convictions will be considered after an individualized assessment of the conviction and the job requirements.**


Base Pay Scale: Generally starting at $31\.77 \- $35\.78 per hour
The salary of the finalist selected for this role will be set based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, internal equity, experience, education, specialty and training. This pay scale is not a promise of a particular wage.

jobs.title: Afterschool Program Leader (KIPP Middle School)
jobs.description:
**Careers** **by** **E****mpowering Futures, Building Communities**

Imagine going to work each day knowing that your efforts positively impact individuals and communities. As a global movement and the nation's leading nonprofit organization dedicated to strengthening communities through youth development, healthy living, and social responsibility, the YMCA of Greater San Francisco offers more than just a job—we offer a career with a future and the opportunity to make a lasting difference in your community. At the Y, you can uncover your passion and build a lifelong career addressing some of the nation's most pressing social issues.  


**Our****Organizational** **Culture**

At the YMCA of Greater San Francisco, we are committed to demonstrating values that aim to building strong communities where you can **Be**, **Belong** and **Become.** With **Truth \& Courage**, we strive to understand and act on individual and societal truths. We ensure a safe and inclusive environment with **Authenticity \& Accessibility**, allowing everyone to participate according to their needs. Our approach is **Dependable \& Creative**, as we respond to community needs through strong partnerships. Above all, we embody **Dignity \& Empathy**, treating everyone with respect and compassion, and recognizing the inherent dignity in all individuals.

**Qualifications**

* 21\+ year old
* Associate’s degree or higher, or High School diploma/equivalent with one of the following:
	+ 48\+ completed college units (verified by transcript),
	+ Passing score on the CA Basic Education Skills Test (CBEST), or
	+ Passing score on a District Instructional Aide Exam.
* Strong teamwork and communication skills
* Knowledge of youth development principles.
* Available Monday–Friday during program hours (\~1:00–6:00 pm).
* TB Test clearance within last 2 years (required for programs on school district sites).



**Preferred** **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in child development or related field.
* Experience working with elementary or middle school\-aged youth.
* Bilingual skills in Spanish, Cantonese, Mandarin, or other languages preferred but not required.
* Knowledge of arts, dance, drama, sports, or other enrichment areas.



**Position Summary**

The After School Program Leader provides meaningful opportunities for youth in YMCA programs at KIPP Middle School. They work under the supervision of Program Site Coordinators and Directors and are expected to demonstrate flexibility, initiative, and punctuality, with a commitment to the school\-year schedule.  

* 
**Job Responsibilities**

**Curriculum Development \& Program Delivery**

* Develop and implement engaging, inclusive, and theme\-based curricula tailored to the developmental and cultural needs of youth.
* Lead academic enrichment sessions, tutoring, and organized outdoor recreational activities.
* Collaborate with staff, parents, and participants to plan program activities.



**Supervision \& Safety**

* Supervise and support groups of up to 20 students, ensuring safety and compliance with YMCA and child\-safe protocols.
* Monitor participants, respond swiftly to critical incidents, and enforce safety regulations.



**Record\-Keeping \& Compliance**

* Maintain accurate program records, including attendance, emergency information, and safety logs.



**Communication \& Engagement**

* Communicate respectfully with participants, parents, staff, and volunteers.



**Training \& Development**

* Complete required safety and program training before the first shift and attend all mandatory meetings and training sessions.



**Work Environment \& Physical Demands**

The After School Program Leader works in a dynamic environment at local elementary or middle school sites, including indoor classrooms and outdoor schoolyards. The role involves frequent standing, walking, and active participation in physical activities such as recreational sports and games. The environment can be fast\-paced and loud, and the role may require occasional lifting of up to 20 pounds.  


**Disclaimers**

* Must successfully complete a background screening, including criminal and employment verification. Some positions may also require a credit check.


* All duties and responsibilities are essential job functions subject to reasonable accommodation. The YMCA of Greater San Francisco promotes an equal employment opportunity workplace, which includes reasonable accommodation for otherwise qualified disabled applicants and employees. Please contact your manager if you have any questions about this policy or these job duties.


* This job description may not be all\-inclusive, and employees are expected to perform other duties as assigned by management. Job descriptions and duties may be modified by management as needed.


* Job offers are conditional and contingent upon background clearance. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and CA Fair Chance Act, we will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records for employment.
  


**Salary Description**

The After School Program Leader \-KIPP Middle School position offers a compensation range of $24\.00 – $25\.50 per hour. This rate is based on salary benchmarking for similar roles and is aligned with grant fund approvals and requirements for the position.

jobs.title: Front End Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
Albertsons' Northern California Market has an opening for a Front End Operations Specialist.



The Front End Operations Specialist (also referred to as Assistant Customer Service Manager) provides positive and proactive leadership and instruction in Customer Service, Retail Integrity, and Operations. Responsible for enhancing the customer service experience, ensuring retail integrity, and achieving budget goals for labor, cash variation, check expense, and supplies across all stores. Oversee the implementation of customer service initiatives. Mentor, develop, and train Store Execution and Retail Integrity Managers to maintain operational excellence and maximize sales and profits. Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and applications in the front\-end.


**Responsibilities**


* Promote a Service First, Second to None culture among Market staff and store associates.
* Direct and monitor store service performance using tools like Customer SAT and service shops.
* Create a customer service culture and environment.
* Provide coaching and training to improve store customer service performance.
* Establish clear objectives with accountability commitments.
* Direct special service operations events such as Service Challenge, area meetings, and Store of the Year.
* Communicate customer expectations and opportunities.
* Develop Market plans and metrics to exceed customer expectations.
* Measure Market performance against plans and metrics.
* Responsible for service content in the Market monthly newsletter.
* Serve as the communication interface between Boise Store Support and the Market.
* Participate in Market, Area, and store meetings, providing verbal and written communication to Market and store personnel.
* Train and mentor staff.
* Plan and facilitate the ongoing development of Service Execution Managers, Retail Integrity Managers, Trainees, Store Service Operations Managers, Service Assistants, and Scan Coordinators.
* Implement and measure the Company’s Core Values through team building, solid training programs, and communication across all departments.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and procedures, including cash management, retail integrity, and adherence to state and federal regulations.
* Oversee all advertisements ensuring promotional information is supported by the Host pricing system and POS Systems.
* Partner with Loss Prevention to address and resolve operational violations and investigations.
* Collaborate with Execution Operations Managers and Installation Services Teams to coordinate the installation of store systems equipment within the Market.

  

  

**Qualifications**



Education Level: Bachelor’s degree in business, finance or related field and/or at least 5 years’ experience in retail store operations preferred.



Experience Level: Experience as a Store Director or Assistant Store Director is helpful



Skills and Experiences


* Financial acumen and analytical skills combined with attention to detail.
* Thorough knowledge of front\-end work methods, fund handling, and scanning procedures.
* Understanding of company scanning and price maintenance support application systems and practices.
* Previous experience in retail store operations with a strong background in scan coordination procedures and methods, preferably with a Retail Scanning Company.
* Complete knowledge of front\-end company policies and procedures.
* Ability to complete store bookkeeping duties.
* Ability to work effectively in a team environment and build relationships.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills to interface with personnel at all levels.
* Proficiency in PC skills and desktop applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Analytical ability.


Travel Requirements: Frequent travel dependent upon geography



Physical Environment


* Most work is performed in a temperature\-controlled office or retail store environment.
* Store visits involve regular standing, walking, climbing stairs, and movement around machinery and hazardous equipment, as well as backstage receiving and production areas.
* Incumbent may sit for long periods at a desk or computer terminal.
* Use of calculators, keyboards, telephones, and other office equipment is required during the normal workday.
* Stopping, bending, twisting, and reaching may be required to complete job duties.

  

  

Albertsons Companies' Northern California Market office is located in Pleasanton, CA and supports the operations of 285 retail stores across northern California, northwestern Nevada, and Hawaii under the Safeway, Andronico’s, Vons, and Pak ‘n Save Foods banners.

  

**Why you will choose us**  

Albertsons Companies has always been a people\-oriented business, and thoughtful people practices remain a core element of our company’s philosophy. As friendly, enthusiastic people who enjoy offering customers an exceptional shopping experience, we provide world\-class customer service each and every day.



We also provide a variety of benefits including:


* Diverse and inclusive work culture
* Competitive pay with weekly payroll
* Access to up to 50% of your earned wages before payday, via our partnership with Stream
* Associate discounts
* Comprehensive benefits for eligible associates, including Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), and more (eligibility details at myACI Benefits: https://myaci\-benefits.com)
* Paid time off: vacation, holidays, and sick leave (eligibility details at myACI Benefits: https://myaci\-benefits.com)
* Leaders invested in your training, career growth \& development


Pay Transparency: Starting rates will be no less than the local minimum wage and may vary based on criteria such as location, experience, and qualifications. Candidates with unique qualifications may be considered for compensation above this range. Benefits may include medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance, sick pay, PTO/Vacation Pay or Flexible Time Off, paid holidays, bereavement pay, and retiremen

jobs.title: Program Manager – El Mercadito/Arcoiris
jobs.description:
Mission Action has been growing rapidly, therefore, we have created a lot of new positions across our different programs and departments. Please consider joining our team to serve the communities.


Mission Action nurtures individual wellness and cultivates collective power among low\-income and immigrant communities to create a more just society. As a multi\-issue, multi\-strategy organization, we work to improve lives on an individual level as well as affect broader social change by engaging in advocacy and community organizing. We work together across programs to address homelessness, lack of affordable housing, and to support immigrant rights in order to meet the complex needs of our communities and collectively address the root causes of suffering and injustice. In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open\-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer\-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.



This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

* Experience in security operations or other functions of security industry

* Enrollment in our company’s 401(k)plan, subject to eligibility requirements
* Eight paid holidays annually, five sick days, and four personal days

jobs.title: Specialist, Quality Assurance
jobs.description:
Yowei Therapeutics and Yowei Oncology are stealth\-stage life\-sciences companies working closely with CSBio to advance peptide\-based clinical programs. Their work spans longevity and peptide therapeutics, clinical trials, evaluation of a 503A pharmacy model, personalized synthetic neoantigen peptide oncology programs, and supporting microbiology and laboratory capabilities. Together, they are building the clinical, pharmacy, data, laboratory, and operational infrastructure needed to responsibly translate peptide programs into patient\-facing studies and services. Both companies expect to remain in stealth through Q1 2027\.


CSBio is a peptide contract manufacturing founded in 1993\. CSBio initial products were a complete line of automated synthesizers for manufacturing and process development, with a focus on cGMP production. In 1994, CSBio opened a custom peptide facility and began producing high quality compounds for research organizations and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. In 2004, CSBio opened a peptide production facility in Menlo Park, CA and in 2014, CSBio expanded production capability through the addition of a new, state of the art building dedicated to cGMP peptide production. In 2017, CSBio passed a FDA inspection and were recommended to be approved for commercial drug substance manufacturing. In 2023, additional cGMP clinical production capacity was added in Milpitas, CA.


We are seeking qualified individuals to join us as Quality Assurance Specialist. Core duties and responsibilities include the following:


Job Duties:

* Support Quality Management System at CSBio encompassing quality investigations including Deviations, CAPAs, and oversee Document Control, Training and Customer Complaints.
* Provide direction, assess and remediate, as appropriate, current and previous validation documentation, including conducting gap assessments, risk assessments, and development of standards.
* Review/approve OOS, deviations, CAPAs, SOPs, and operation documents.
* Create and provide guidance on phase\-appropriate processes and systems.
* Review Risk Assessments, Process Development Reports, and Protocols.
* Quality support of the validation system to ensure quality and compliance requirements are met in an efficient and effective manner.
* Quality support and approval of validation related documentation (e.g., IQ, OQ, PQ, etc.); this includes process, facilities, utilities, equipment, test methods, cleaning and software validations.
* Work with Operations, Manufacturing, Quality Control, and Validation to maintain a validation assessment plan for all GXP assets, buildings, systems, including laboratory instrumentation and systems.
* Apply sound, systematic problem\-solving methodologies in identifying, prioritizing, communicating, and resolving quality issues.
* Support the recall process including initiation, customer and regulatory notification, and product withdrawal.
* Identify and manage continuous improvement projects with the objective of achieving quality and efficiency in processes.


Competencies:

* To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies:
* Problem Solving \- Identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner; Gathers and analyzes information skillfully; Develops alternative solutions; Works well in group problem solving situations.
* Teamwork \- Balances team and individual responsibilities; Exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views; Gives and welcomes feedback; Supports everyone's efforts to succeed.
* Organizational Support \- Follows policies and procedures; Completes tasks correctly and on time; Supports organization goals and values.
* Motivation \- Sets and achieves challenging goals; Demonstrates persistence and overcomes obstacles; Measures self against standard of excellence.
* Adaptability \- Adapts to changes in the work environment; Manages competing demands; Changes approach or method to best fit the situation; Able to deal with frequent change, delays, or unexpected events.

  

**Requirements**  

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Chemistry, or related field
* 3\+ years in Manufacturing or Quality Control in a pharmaceutical, medical device or drug manufacturing company
* 2\+ years in Quality Assurance in a pharmaceutical, medical device or drug manufacturing company
* Strong GMP knowledge and in depth understanding of ICH and FDA regulations
* Thorough understanding of problem\-solving and quality improvement tools and techniques
* Ability to work effectively and collaboratively in a cross\-functional team within a fast\-paced environment

  

**Benefits**  

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance (Kaiser HMO or BlueShield PPO. Employer pays 85% for Employee and 50% for Employee’s family; Dental: Aetna Dental, Delta Dental, Guardian Dental, MetLife Dental. Vision: VSP and Aetna EyeMed)
* Basic life ($20,000 paid by company) and supplemental life insurance (optional supplemental).
* Disability insurance 50% standard employer paid.
* 401k 10% 1:1 match
* PTO policy. 10 days PTO
* Companywide paid holiday during: Week of July 4, Thanksgiving (2 days), Week of December 25
* Carpool, clean air vehicle, and cell phone reimbursement
* Employee rewards and recognition program
* Company organized social events
* Quarterly sponsored team building activities

jobs.title: Product Ops Manager, Facebook Social & Meta AI
jobs.description:
Meta is seeking a Product Operations Manager to join Facebook Product Operations and drive product quality, AI\-powered automation, and operational excellence across FB's surfaces, specifically Social's hypergrowth app releases. We are in the middle of a transformation, becoming an AI\-driven, individual\-contributor\-led organization that scales through orchestration, deep product expertise, and technical excellence. Our team is building and operating autonomous agents that handle end\-to\-end workflows (triage, bug resolution, launches, dogfooding, evals) with minimal human intervention.If you're energized by owning complex quality programs end\-to\-end, building and operating AI\-driven workflows, and driving measurable product improvements in a fast\-paced environment, this role is for you.You will be responsible for investigating and communicating the quality of FB's products to engineering, product, design, and other cross\-functional partners. You will own AI builds for collecting, generating, and triaging reported quality issues. Additionally, you will partner with product and engineering teams to implement process and tooling improvements focused on driving developer efficiency, resolution of issues, and improved product quality.  

  

  

### **Product Ops Manager, Facebook Social \& Meta AI Responsibilities:**

* Become an expert in the health and quality of Facebook's Social and AI products, identifying trends, regressions, and user pain points through data analysis and hands\-on product usage
* Own end\-to\-end product quality programs for your area, including launches, dogfooding, root cause analyses, incident reviews, and app health regressions automating first and operating with high reliability
* Design, build, and operate autonomous AI agents and workflows for your product area: bug triage, prioritization, classification, deduplication, and resolution
* Partner with engineering and product teams to drive resolution of high\-priority issues and influence product roadmap based on quality insights
* Prepare communication materials and progress tracking for multiple audiences including delivering updates to leadership stakeholders
* Collect, analyze, and leverage data to identify quality trends and inform product decisions
* build dashboards and metrics to drive data\-driven decision making
* Build and maintain an evaluation (evals) practice for your area, ensuring AI solutions meet accuracy thresholds through LLM judges, labellers, and governance frameworks
* Assess and improve existing AI solutions within your scope, driving migration to standard platforms and partnering with AI Implementations leadership on scaling decisions
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams and Foundations partners to align on org\-wide priorities and share best practices
* Design and operate AI workflows that comply with Facebook data sensitivity guardrails, ensuring quality signals are collected and processed within encryption boundaries and privacy\-first constraints

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a directly related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 5\+ years of related strategy, operations, consulting, or data analyst experience
* Analytical experience using data to tell a story and influence product direction using intermediate to advanced SQL
* Experience building or deploying AI/ML solutions or automation in production workflows
* Strong communication skills with ability to influence multiple cross\-functional stakeholders and senior leadership
* Experience breaking down ambiguous issues into component parts to develop and implement solutions
* Experience with AI products / platforms, with understanding of mobile\-first product behaviors, encryption, and multi\-platform feature parity

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Prior experience working on or with Facebook or comparable large\-scale messaging products
* Experience in product quality, QA, or technical program management
* Familiarity with LLMs, AI agents, or ML evaluation frameworks
* Experience operating effectively in organizations with minimal hierarchy, taking ownership of workstreams with high individual autonomy
* Experience working with global/remote teams

  

  

  

### **About Meta:**


Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  

  

  

Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Meta participates in the E\-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. Please note that Meta may leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies in connection with applications for employment.
  

  

Meta is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations\-

jobs.title: Patient Engagement Specialist I
jobs.description:
**Job Description Summary**


‎


Patient Engagement Specialist I supports patient access by performing routine scheduling, call handling, information verification, message routing, and documentation tasks in a centralized or practice\-based patient engagement setting. Assists with appointment scheduling, patient inquiries, demographic updates, insurance information capture, care team message routing, and patient communication under established procedures. Supports accurate patient service and timely access by following approved scripts, workflows, and escalation guidelines.  

  

Patient Engagement Specialist I works under close supervision on clearly defined tasks within established parameters. Decisions are limited in scope and impact own work products. Builds foundational knowledge of patient engagement, scheduling workflows, patient communication standards, electronic medical record documentation, and service procedures through structured assignments with frequent guidance from more experienced team members.
‎

**How will you make an impact \& Requirements**


‎

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Answer incoming patient calls, messages, or requests using approved scripts, workflows, and service standards.

jobs.title: Oncology Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Oncology Account Manager \- Pacific NW**


**Cycle Company:** Cycle Pharmaceuticals Inc


**Location:** Remote position but candidates will live in either San Francisco, Sacramento, Washington or Oregon and you are local to the nearest airport as this role requires up to 70% travel.


**Salary Range:** $170,000 \- $200,000 depending on experience.


**Position Summary:** This is a full\-time position working within our oncology sales team.

  


**The Opportunity**



We're looking for an experienced and passionate Oncology Account Manager to join our sales team to help drive our mission forward within the oncology space. This is a unique opportunity to be part of something truly meaningful at a pivotal moment in our expansion.



These are foundational roles within our newest therapeutic area, giving you the chance to make a real impact and support patients living with rare hematologic and oncologic conditions.



You'll join a driven and fast\-growing organization with a strong track record within the oncology pharma space. You'll have the opportunity to lead engagement with HCPs and clinics across your territory, educate on disease and treatment pathways, and support access via our specialty pharmacy and/or Cycle Vita patient hub. You'll also collaborate cross\-functionally to help drive launch success and build strong relationships across the haematology/oncology landscape.

  


**Our Company**



At Cycle Pharmaceuticals, we believe that **Every Single Patient Matters**. This is at the heart of why we work and were looking for people to join our team who share our vision. We know that life\-changing treatments need life\-improving product support to match, because when you put the two together, great things can happen.



At Cycle Pharma, we focus on providing treatments and services for patients with neurological, rare metabolic, and rare immunological conditions, most of which are genetic conditions. Some of our patients are diagnosed with a rare disease at birth, others are affected later in life, and some can spend years trying to get diagnosed. No matter what stage our patients or their caregivers are at, we strive to provide them with the support they require. If you want to know more about what we do then, why not check out our website below and look at some of our patient stories:



Patient Stories \- Cycle Pharma

  


**What you will be doing**


* Drive adoption of Cycle Pharmaceuticals leading haematology and oncology therapies across haematology and oncology by engaging with physicians, nurses, and healthcare staff through face\-to\-face and virtual channels.
* Build awareness of oncology rare disease conditions, therapeutic solutions, and the individualized support services available through Cycle Vita.
* Educate providers on prescribing pathways within community oncology, Cycle Vita patient hub, and specialty pharmacies to streamline patient access to treatments.
* Identify, engage, and partner with key opinion leaders to support peer\-to\-peer education and community outreach.
* Lead territory\-level execution of new product launches and marketing strategies to maximize reach and impact.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Market Access, Marketing, and Field Leadership to align on strategy and field insights.
* Ensure accurate CRM documentation, maintain compliance, and develop and deliver quarterly business plans tailored to your market dynamics.

  


**What you'll bring**


* Bachelor's degree required.
* Experience in haematology and oncology required.
* Proven successful field\-based sales experience in biopharmaceuticals.
* Proven ability to meet/exceed performance goals.
* Collaborative, ethical, and proactive team player.
* Strong communication and CRM/data skills.
* Willingness to travel up to 70%.
* Valid driver's license and clean driving record.

  


**What makes this role special**


* Be part of building something new from the ground up.
* Make a meaningful difference in the lives of patients with serious, underserved conditions.
* Work across diverse therapeutic areas and projects.
* Join a team that values agility, initiative, and collaboration.
* Learn from leaders with deep experience and strong patient focus.

  


**What can we offer to you**


* A homebased, flexible work environment with extensive travel, up to 70%.
* Competitive salary and performance\-based bonus
* Employer funded private health insurance
* Life insurance and 401(k) plan
* Agile working policy and home\-based flexibility
* A fast\-paced, supportive, and ambitious work environment

  


**Applications**


*At Cycle Pharmaceuticals, we are committed to creating an inclusive, respectful, positive and diverse workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, gender, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. We actively support and embrace diversity, and we are working to build a team that reflects a wide range of backgrounds and perspectives.*


*We value your unique contributions and encourage you to join us in shaping a more inclusive future. If you require any reasonable adjustments \- whether during the application process or in the workplace \- we will be happy to support your needs. At Cycle, equality, inclusion, and respect are at the core of everything we do. We fully comply with all applicable employment laws, including those related to non\-discrimination, work authorization, and employment eligibility verification.*

Overview:

Marin Community Clinics, founded in 1972, is today, a multi\-clinic network with a wide array of integrated primary care, dental, behavioral, specialty and referral services. As a Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC), we provide vital health services to almost 40,000 individuals annually in Marin County. The Clinics regularly receive national awards from the Health Resources and Services Administrations (HRSA). Our Mission is to promote health and wellness through excellent, compassionate care for all.

  

Marin Community Clinics is looking for a mission\-driven Associate Case Manager to join our dynamic, multidisciplinary, Complex Care team to advance our goal of improving health outcomes for individuals with complex medical, behavioral health, and psychosocial needs. Our Complex Care team is committed to increasing health equity among Marin’s most vulnerable patients through person\-centered, trauma\-informed, case management support. Working collaboratively with primary care, behavioral health, and other members of the clinical care team, the Associate Case Manager works as a member of an expert team of professionals to provide patient\-centered, outcome\- driven care that promotes independence and dignity.

Qualifications:

* MA, CHW, Bachelor of SW or equivalent case management experience required.
* 1\-2 years’ experience (and passion for) providing support to individuals with chronic and complex BH needs, complex medical conditions and/or substance\-using individuals highly preferable.

* Prolonged standing and walking.
* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* Must be able to lift to 15 pounds at times.
* Will drive among clinic locations as needed.
* Fulfill immunization and fit for duty regulatory requirements.

Our benefits program is designed to protect your health, family and way of life. jobs.title: Partner Enablement Specialist
jobs.description:
**Our Story**


Campfire is a next\-gen core accounting platform built for modern mid\-market finance teams. We help them close fast and scale even faster. Our platform replaces outdated legacy ERPs and manual accounting processes with automation\-driven solutions that simplify and accelerate finance workflows. In the past year alone, we have grown 10x, driven by strong customer demand and a product that delivers real results for accounting \& finance teams. We are scaling quickly and building the future of finance by giving teams the clarity, control, and strategic visibility they need to lead with confidence.

**Role Overview**


As Partner Enablement Specialist, your mission is to make sure every external implementation partner can deliver the Campfire standard as reliably as our internal team does. You'll take the training curriculum and standards developed for internal onboarding and adapt them for an external audience — building the certification bootcamps, materials, and ongoing support that keep partners accurate, confident, and self\-sufficient. This is a hands\-on, execution\-focused role: you're not designing the overall onboarding architecture, you're the person who makes sure partners actually learn it, pass it, and keep up with it as the product evolves.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Partner Bootcamp Delivery*

* Run scheduled Partner Bootcamps, adapting the internal onboarding curriculum into partner\-facing training sessions, workshops, and materials.
* Own the partner certification process: administer assessments, track completion, and issue certifications against the rubrics defined by the Product Enablement Manager.
* Maintain a partner\-facing knowledge base (guides, FAQs, troubleshooting docs) that mirrors internal SOPs but is tailored for external use.

*Partner Readiness \& Support*

* Serve as the first point of contact for partner questions during and after certification.
* Monitor partner\-led implementations for early signs of drift from the Campfire standard, and flag recurring issues back to the Product Enablement Manager.
* Collect partner feedback on training gaps, confusing configurations, or product friction, and route it upstream.

*Content Maintenance*

* Keep partner training materials in sync as product changes roll out — update decks, scripts, and guides in real\-time under the direction of the Product Enablement Manager.
* Help build out video modules and self\-serve certification paths as the partner program scales.

*Cross\-Functional Coordination*

* Partner with the Head of Solution Consulting Partnerships and the Accounting Partnerships Lead to coordinate bootcamp logistics — aligning on scheduling, partner cohorts, and readiness timelines for each partnership track.
* Work with the Accounting Partnerships Lead to ensure bootcamp content reflects the specific configurations and workflows accounting partners need to certify on.
* Work with the Head of Solution Consulting Partnerships to align solution consulting partner training with evolving deal and implementation requirements.

**Requirements**

* 1–3 years of experience in implementation, customer success, or training/enablement — ideally with some direct Campfire product exposure.
* Strong communicator who can explain technical configuration steps clearly to an external audience with less context than an internal hire.
* Organized and detail\-oriented: comfortable owning a certification pipeline and tracking who's where in it.
* Comfortable running live sessions (bootcamps, workshops) as well as producing written/video materials.
* This is an execution and delivery role, not a design\-from\-scratch role — success means faithfully scaling what's already been built, not reinventing it.

jobs.description:
**About Handshake**
===================


Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million\+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.


In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest\-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We’ve grown from $0 to \~$1B run rate and pay \~$60M to over 30K individuals every month.

**Why join Handshake now:**

* Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel
* Partner hand\-in\-hand with world\-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world’s top educational institutions
* Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders
* Build a massive, fast\-growing business with billions in revenue

  

**About the Role**
==================


Account Management at Handshake owns **Gross Revenue Retention (GRR), Net Revenue Retention (NRR), renewals, and expansion revenue** across our customer base.


As an **Account Manager, SMB / Mid\-Market**, you'll own the commercial relationship and growth strategy for a portfolio of approximately **75–130 customers**, acting as a strategic commercial owner rather than a contract\-execution renewal rep. You’ll be accountable for retaining and growing revenue while helping customers maximize the value of their partnership with Handshake.


You’ll partner closely with Customer Success, Sales, RevOps, Product, Support, Finance, and Legal to develop account strategies, mitigate risk, navigate complex customer needs, and identify opportunities to deepen and expand customer relationships.


This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing **strategic account management, consultative selling, customer advocacy, and operational rigor**. You’ll manage customers at different stages of their lifecycle and prioritize your time based on retention risk, expansion potential, and overall business impact.

* Own commercial strategy across a portfolio of approximately 75–130 SMB and/or Mid\-Market customers, with accountability for GRR, NRR, renewals, and expansion performance
* Develop and execute strategic account plans that identify customer priorities, business outcomes, retention risks, expansion opportunities, and paths to long\-term growth
* Proactively manage the renewal lifecycle from early strategy and stakeholder alignment through negotiation and close
* Lead commercial negotiations involving pricing, packaging, contract terms, multi\-year agreements, and complex renewal scenarios
* Identify, qualify, and close expansion opportunities across additional licenses, products, and multi\-product offerings to increase NRR
* Build multi\-threaded relationships with champions, decision\-makers, and executive stakeholders to reduce churn risk and unlock growth
* Partner closely with Customer Success to connect product adoption and demonstrated customer value to renewal and expansion strategies
* Lead strategic customer conversations focused on business priorities, ROI, future needs, and opportunities to expand the partnership
* Proactively identify accounts at risk and develop clear retention and mitigation strategies in partnership with internal stakeholders
* Navigate complex customer situations—including competitive evaluations, budget pressure, organizational changes, product concerns, and procurement—with sound commercial judgment and customer empathy
* Maintain a clear understanding of portfolio health, including renewal status, expansion pipeline, account risk, stakeholder engagement, and growth potential
* Own accurate and timely forecasting, pipeline management, and opportunity hygiene across revenue systems
* Prioritize your portfolio effectively, balancing high\-touch strategic engagement with scalable account management motions
* Surface customer insights and trends to Product, Sales, Customer Success, and leadership to help improve our product and go\-to\-market strategy
* Contribute to the continued evolution of Account Management by sharing best practices and identifying opportunities to improve processes, playbooks, segmentation, automation, and operating rhythms

  

**Desired Capabilities**
========================

* 2\+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, Sales, Renewals, or another customer\-facing B2B SaaS role
* 1\+ years owning commercial outcomes such as renewals, expansion, upsell, cross\-sell, or revenue retention
* Track record managing and growing a portfolio of B2B SaaS customers and associated ARR
* Proven ability to lead renewal and expansion opportunities from strategy through negotiation and close
* Strong commercial acumen with the ability to balance customer needs with business objectives
* Experience identifying customer risk and developing strategies to protect and improve retention
* Experience managing pipeline and producing accurate forecasts against retention and/or expansion targets
* Ability to build credibility and influence across multiple levels of a customer organization, including senior stakeholders and decision\-makers
* Strong prioritization and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple customer opportunities and deadlines simultaneously
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to navigate strategic, commercial, and difficult customer conversations
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills across Customer Success, Sales, Product, Support, Finance, Legal, and RevOps

  

***Extra Credit***
==================

* Experience managing SMB and/or Mid\-Market SaaS customers with responsibility for both retention and expansion
* Experience carrying a renewal, expansion, or revenue quota and con

jobs.description:
**ABOUT LEGION HEALTH**
=======================


At Legion Health, we believe everyone deserves fast, affordable, and world\-class health care, and we’re developing the AI infrastructure to deliver it ourselves at world scale.


Legion is building **autonomous medical care** (the AI doctor), starting with psychiatry. Our AI\-native care\-delivery platform currently automates 95% of the administrative work required for us to deliver direct patient care. We also recently became the first company ever to receive regulatory authorization to let AI prescribe psychiatric medications, allowing us to not only collapse health care’s admin costs but also its clinical labor costs—**shifting this industry’s economics from humans to tokens.**


Our technical moat is hard to copy—we combine **rich data, production AI, doctors in the loop, and end\-to\-end care operations** to deliver measurably better care to a clinically complex patient population. This has helped us produce **tens of thousands of total visits in just 2 years**, all while holding ops costs flat and achieving industry\-leading patient NPS and retention. While the last generation of healthcare startups made the existing system incrementally more efficient, Legion is rebuilding full\-stack care delivery from first principles. **Our vision?** A 10X better patient experience that’s higher quality, less expensive, and more scalable than ever before. And a 10X better clinician experience that frees our providers to focus on what matters most: caring for patients.


Legion Health is backed by **Y Combinator,** leading venture capital firms, and founders from Function Health, Modern Health, Everly Health, Trusted Health, Clipboard Health, PatientPing, Sesame Care, Faire, EasyPost, and fuboTV.


Join us as we build the future of health care: faster, higher\-quality, and more affordable, powered by doctors and AI working together.

**ROLE LOGISTICS**
==================

* Job Type: Full\-Time
* Role Type: Sales Enablement / Onboarding / Field Training / Provider Partnerships
* Ideal Experience Level: 4\+ years in sales enablement, sales training, or a closely related role
* Location: Onsite in San Francisco, CA
* Travel: Periodic field visits to support coaching and learning, aiming for 2–3 field days per month when feasible

**THE OPPORTUNITY**
===================


Legion is hiring a Sales Enablement Lead to build the training and readiness system behind our provider\-partnership team. You will help Provider Partnership Managers and Regional Managers learn the market, tell Legion's story accurately, execute the field motion, and build productive relationships with referring care teams.


Your first priority is new\-hire onboarding: a focused one\-to\-two\-week program with clear certification standards, practical rehearsal, and a strong bridge into the field. You will partner closely with Provider Partnerships leadership, Regional Managers, Revenue Operations, and clinical and operations experts. Enablement owns readiness, training, and learning systems. jobs.title: Therapeutic Account Manager, Liver - Palo Alto
jobs.description:
**MISSION**



Mirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases. We are passionate about advancing scientific discoveries to become important medicines for rare disease patients. We are collaborative, creative, and experienced professionals and we're looking to augment our team with other individuals who embody our values: care, be real, get it done, and have fun, seriously.

**POSITION SUMMARY**



The Therapeutic Account Manager (TAM) is responsible for delivering strong, sustainable business performance and meaningful patient impact across an assigned territory. The TAM develops deep clinical and account expertise in rare cholestatic liver diseases and Mirum's Liver portfolio; identifies and prioritizes high\-opportunity customers, accounts, and referral networks; and executes customized account plans that advance disease awareness, appropriate patient identification, treatment consideration, initiation, and persistence in accordance with approved indications and promotional practices.



The ideal TAM is not a transactional seller. This individual is a clinically credible, insight\-led partner who engages healthcare professionals as a peer, asks thoughtful questions, constructively challenges clinical inertia, and influences change across complex accounts. The TAM works closely with the Regional Business Director and cross\-functional partners to connect customer needs, patient journeys, referral pathways, access dynamics, and business opportunities while demonstrating curiosity, high emotional intelligence, resilience, ownership, and consistent follow\-through.


**JOB FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES**


**Territory Strategy \& Business Performance**


* Develop and execute a focused territory business plan aligned with national, zone, and regional priorities, with clear objectives, customer priorities, resource allocation, and measures of success.
* Use performance data, customer insights, market intelligence, access dynamics, and competitive trends to identify opportunities, anticipate barriers, and make timely adjustments to territory strategy and execution.
* Delivers territory business objectives through disciplined prioritization, high\-quality customer engagement, effective resource stewardship, and accountability for both behaviors and results.
* Maintain accurate and timely customer records, forecasts, expense reporting, required administrative documentation, and business updates in accordance with company expectations.


**Strategic Account Management \& Network Development**


* Identify, prioritize, and develop high\-opportunity accounts, health systems, centers of excellence, and referral networks across pediatric and adult hepatology and gastroenterology.
* Create and execute customized account plans that reflect the local patient journey, key stakeholders, clinical decision\-making, referral patterns, access considerations, customer needs, and competitive realities.
* Build trusted relationships with physicians, advanced practice providers, nurses, pharmacists, office staff, and other members of the care team by delivering relevant value and consistent follow\-through.
* Map influence and decision\-making within complex accounts, establish clear objectives for each engagement, and secure appropriate next steps that advance the account strategy.
* Coordinate compliant account actions across Mirum field partners, clarify ownership, and maintain momentum against agreed priorities and customer needs.


**Clinical Aptitude \& Customer Engagement**


* Develop and maintain deep knowledge of rare cholestatic liver disease, diagnostic pathways, mechanisms of action, clinical data, product profiles, approved uses, safety information, patient support pathways, access and reimbursement, and the evolving competitive landscape.
* Communicate complex scientific and clinical information clearly, accurately, and credibly, tailoring the discussion to the knowledge, needs, and priorities of each healthcare professional and account.
* Engage healthcare professionals as a clinically credible peer by asking insightful questions, listening actively, uncovering unmet needs, and connecting relevant evidence and resources to the customer's practice.
* Execute approved promotional programs, resources, and customer engagements with consistency, clinical relevance, sound judgment, and full adherence to company policies and regulatory requirements.


**Influence \& Impact**


* Help customers recognize gaps in disease awareness, patient identification, referral, treatment consideration, and ongoing support by reframing issues and connecting insights across the patient journey.
* Use high emotional intelligence, curiosity, credibility, and thoughtful questioning to build trust with skeptical, change\-resistant, or highly experienced healthcare professionals.
* Influence multiple stakeholders without authority, navigate resistance constructively, and balance persistence with judgment, empathy, and respect for customer boundaries


**Customer, Patient \& Caregiver Impact**


* Keep patients and caregivers at the center of territory and account decisions, with a clear understanding of the journey from disease recognition and diagnosis through treatment initiation and persistence.
* Support a customer experience grounded in trust, empathy, responsiveness, urgency, and reliable follow\-through with healthcare professionals and care teams.
* Collaborate compliantly with Market Access and Patient Services partners to help care teams understand available resources and navigate appropriate barriers in the patient journey.
* Identify recurring customer, access, and patient\-support barriers; elevate them objectively and promptly; and partner with the appropriate internal teams to improve execution and support.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Field Insights**


* Build productive partnerships with Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Services,

jobs.title: Therapeutic Account Manager, Liver - Palo Alto
jobs.description:
**MISSION**



Mirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases. We are passionate about advancing scientific discoveries to become important medicines for rare disease patients. We are collaborative, creative, and experienced professionals and we're looking to augment our team with other individuals who embody our values: care, be real, get it done, and have fun, seriously.

**POSITION SUMMARY**



The Therapeutic Account Manager (TAM) is responsible for delivering strong, sustainable business performance and meaningful patient impact across an assigned territory. The TAM develops deep clinical and account expertise in rare cholestatic liver diseases and Mirum's Liver portfolio; identifies and prioritizes high\-opportunity customers, accounts, and referral networks; and executes customized account plans that advance disease awareness, appropriate patient identification, treatment consideration, initiation, and persistence in accordance with approved indications and promotional practices.



The ideal TAM is not a transactional seller. This individual is a clinically credible, insight\-led partner who engages healthcare professionals as a peer, asks thoughtful questions, constructively challenges clinical inertia, and influences change across complex accounts. The TAM works closely with the Regional Business Director and cross\-functional partners to connect customer needs, patient journeys, referral pathways, access dynamics, and business opportunities while demonstrating curiosity, high emotional intelligence, resilience, ownership, and consistent follow\-through.
