jobs.title: Product Operations Specialist | Procurement
jobs.description:
**About Ramp**
==============


Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000\+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.


The problems are high\-stakes, data\-dense, and unforgiving.


We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.


The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.


If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

**About the Role**
==================


As a Product Operations partner for Ramp Procurement, you will help build and scale the workflows that enable customers to manage their procurement processes with speed, accuracy, and control. You will improve both the requester and approver experience while shaping product quality through data, customer feedback, and tight partnership with customer\-facing internal teams.


Beyond your product vertical, you will also contribute to Product Operations process improvement and product building that allows our Product and Engineering teams to scale. You will use AI tools to improve release management, collect customer feedback, and enable internal teams to support customers and troubleshoot issues.


Our main goal is to reduce customer friction, measured by support tickets per active user and customer NPS.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Own the voice\-of\-customer loop for Procurement — systematically capture, analyze, and prioritize feedback from CX, Sales, and direct customer channels
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and Design to translate customer feedback into actionable product requirements and specs
* Own launch operations for new Procurement features as they move from Alpha to GA, including AI\-native experiences that require strong customer and internal enablement
* Directly ship product improvements (UX fixes and paper cuts) using AI tools — owning your own backlog of customer friction reduction, not just feeding the engineering backlog
* Use AI to automate processes and build products that enable teams to ship faster while maintaining a high quality bar
* Build scalable operating systems for release readiness, internal enablement, supportability, and issue escalation across Procurement workflows

**What You Need**
-----------------

* 3\+ years in product operations, product management, or a customer\-facing analytical role supporting B2B SaaS; experience with procurement, intake and approval workflows, spend management, or financial operations preferred
* Proficiency using data to size opportunities and analyze adoption, support trends, payment flow performance, and customer friction
* Ability to translate qualitative feedback into crisp requirements and operational processes
* Comfort working in ambiguous, technically complex spaces and driving clarity across multiple stakeholders
* Strong problem solving, prioritization, and communication skills; bias to ship improvements quickly and measure impact
* Experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude Code) to accelerate your work and directly make product improvements

**About Our Teams**
-------------------

* **Spend Management** owns our core spend product, including card issuance, reimbursements, and travel \& entertainment to control spend
* **Procurement** owns streamlining new purchase requests, approvals, vendors, savings, and price intelligence products to help companies make better financial decisions
* **Intelligence** owns the reporting, savings, and price intelligence products to help companies make better financial decisions
* **Bill Payments** owns our invoice management, accounts payable, and B2B payment capabilities
* **Risk** owns our underwriting and financial products that determine which businesses to approve and how to manage risk
* **Growth** owns onboarding, activation and retention products to help our customers be successful on the Ramp platform
* **Accounting** owns creating intelligence in our accounting platform, saving finance teams time and money
* **Mobile** owns our mobile app development and mobile strategy

**Benefits available to all full\-time Ramp employees (Global)**
----------------------------------------------------------------

* Flexible PTO
* Centralized home\-office equipment ordering
* Health and wellness stipend
* Budget for intra\-office travel
* Weekly coffee stipend

**United States**
-----------------

* 100% medical, dental \& vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents
* One Medical annual membership
* 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp
* Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)
* Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing \+ bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay
* Pet insurance
* In\-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more
* Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

**Canada**
----------

* Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life
* Life, AD\&D, and disability coverage
* Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)
* Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP \+ DPSP)
* Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing \+ bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay
* Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

**United Kingdom**
------------------

* Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite
* Virtual GP and at\-home care via eMed x Livi
* Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifi

jobs.description:
**We are:**


Accenture's Life Sciences Reinventive Enterprise practice leads AI\-driven enterprise transformation at the world's leading pharmaceutical and biotechnology organizations. We deploy the Reinvention Force: a human \+ AI team of Transformers, Workforce Architects, and AI \& Data Innovators that makes reinvention real at enterprise scale.  

This is a high\-visibility, high\-impact practice with strong momentum and a clear path to Managing Director for high performers.

 **You are:**


An experienced practitioner with proven delivery expertise in your domain. You are analytically rigorous and structured in your thinking. You communicate complex ideas clearly to senior stakeholders. You are comfortable operating in ambiguous environments and thrive in cross\-functional delivery teams. You have supported business development and are ready to take on more. You bring intellectual curiosity, drive, and a genuine interest in how AI is transforming the Life Sciences industry.

  

The Learning \& Development Partner designs and delivers role\-specific training for redesigned roles within the pod's functional scope. This role builds the training curriculum, coordinates delivery alongside each AI release, and measures learning effectiveness to ensure the organization is ready to operate in new ways.

 **The work:**

* Design and deliver role\-specific training for redesigned roles within the pod's functional scope
* Build the training curriculum and coordinate delivery alongside each new technology and AI agent release
* Translate process and role redesigns into practical, accessible learning content for functional audiences
* Measure training effectiveness and learner adoption — adjust curriculum based on feedback and adoption data
* Collaborate with the Workforce Design Lead and change management team to align training with the overall change plan.
* Travel varies by client needs and could be up to 80%

  

**Here’s what you need:**

  

Candidates must have at least 5 years of combined experience in the following:

  

* Instructional design, curriculum development, or enterprise learning in a consulting or corporate environment
* Designing role\-based training programs for technology or process transformation programs
* Experience with digital training delivery platforms and learning management systems (Cornerstone, Workday Learning, or equivalent)
* Ability to translate technical process and role changes into practical, accessible learning content for non\-technical audiences
* Experience measuring training effectiveness with data\-driven curriculum refinement

 **Bonus points if you have:**

  

* ATD, CPTD, or equivalent instructional design certification
* Experience using AI\-generated content tools to accelerate training curriculum development and personalization
* Background in Life Sciences regulatory or compliance training design
* Familiarity with AI\-enabled learning platforms and adaptive learning technologies
* Experience coordinating training delivery across multiple simultaneous technology releases

jobs.description:
**We are:**


Accenture Song accelerates growth and value for our clients through sustained customer relevance. Our capabilities span ideation to execution: growth, product and experience design; technology and experience platforms; creative, media and marketing strategy; and campaign, content and channel orchestration. With strong client relationships and deep industry expertise, we help our clients operate at the speed of life through the unlimited potential of imagination, technology and intelligence. Visit us at: www.accenture.com/song

**You are:**  

An expert in customer support and contact centers, with an understanding of the software / technology that enables day\-to\-day operations. You understand the ins and outs of customer support organizations what drives call volume, how to unlock and deliver customer value and think about customer support in a digital, self\-service manner and you’re ready to apply your knowledge to help clients optimize and transform their customer service solutions. You’ve led a customer support transformation previously are currently experimenting with how GenAI can impact your business and understand large scale technology delivery. Additionally, you are familiar with the selling processes, and you’ve pitched proposals with business cases and solutions to help solve problems. Working in an agile, fast\-paced environment energizes you, and you’re at your best when contributing to a team. You’re always ready to dive deep into creative and analytical thinking to solve problems and transform challenges into opportunities. Leadership and verbal skills Yours are top\-drawer, and you know how to work well with everyone from junior colleagues to executive stakeholders.

 **The work:**

* Evaluate clients’ current customer service offerings, identify gaps, shape vision, provide recommendations and propose strategic solutions that address their unique needs and business goals
* Define business cases, business and implementation roadmaps, and execute solutions
* Lead delivery teams to redesign clients’ organizational structure, processes, and technology capabilities so they can deliver optimal customer service experiences
* Collaborate with visual designers and analytic teams to generate insights and deliver customer centric, insight driven solutions
* Advise clients on ways to measure and improve their customer\-centric metrics
* Lead change\-management initiatives that drive adoption, ease implementation, and position clients’ customer\-service solutions for ongoing success
* Establish relationships with client stakeholders and build long\-term partnerships for Accenture
* Identify opportunities and drive business development efforts to build the Accenture Consulting practice
* Manage and coach junior team members, and continue to grow your own expertise
* Contribute to perspectives and thought leadership to help Accenture maintain its thought\-leadership position


Travel: As required for client support.


Location: Primary residency within 90 minutes of an approved Accenture office


  

**Here’s what you’ll need:**

* A minimum three (3\) years of management consulting experience with heavy focus working in customer service, customer support, contact center environment or digital customer field including:
	+ Solutioning and selling new ideas and proposals
	+ Incorporating experience design and analytics into customer service, and support processes
* 3\+ years of experience working with: Cloud (SaaS) solutions and determining how they fit into a client’s larger application ecosystem
* 3\+ years of experience working with Customer service platform technologies (such as Salesforce, Dynamics, Amazon Connect, Genesys, NICE etc.)
* 1\+ years of experience working with Artificial intelligence and front\-end digital platforms
* 3\+ years of deep functional knowledge in two or more of the following areas: customer service transformation, customer service experience design and customer service process implementation, contact forecasting and work force management, quality management, center staffing and training, technology support, IVR design and implementation, digital customer service technology platforms/Call routing, reporting metrics/KPIs, and supplier/contract management

 **Bonus points if:**

* Experience in evaluating benchmark data (e. g. customer, process, financial benchmarks); web/chat/ email contacts, social media, contact center technology sales or project management experience with center start\-ups, consolidation or outsourcing
* Experience in conducting analysis against benchmarks, producing recommendations, and performing implementations as a result of analysis and recommendations
* Have hands on experience with artificial intelligence, GenAI and conversational design
* Experience in one of more of the industry verticals: Hi\-Tech, Communications \& Media, Health/Healthcare, Financial Services, Life Science/MedTech

  

Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, and level of experience. jobs.title: Assistant Security Account Manager
jobs.description:
Assistant Security Account Manager

**Overview**
------------

  

Company Overview:
Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.**Job Description**
-------------------

  

Allied Universal is looking to hire an Assistant Account Manager. The Assistant Account Manager job is responsible for assisting the Account Manager with all supervisory, training and operations functions at the assigned post in accordance with post orders and client instructions, and following all internal procedures. To support and ensure success in this role, we provide a comprehensive, week\-long management onboarding course designed to provide best practices, tools and guidance.
**RESPONSIBILITIES:*** Under the direction of the Account Manager, this position assists with the coordination of all aspects (technical and managerial) of executing the security contract at the assigned location. Assigns work tasks to Security Professionals and directs their work throughout the day
* This position is the first direct supervisory contact for shift supervisors (if applicable to site) or for Security Professionals, regarding performance, operations, and department needs. Responsible for supervising, motivating, coaching and training Also responsible for evaluating the work performance of Security Professionals and making recommendations regarding assignments
* Responsible for making sure that Post Order manual and all other post and training information is being properly maintained and updated, and that the Post is being properly maintained, cleaned and organized
* Assist the Account Manager in conducting interviews and evaluating new employees. Responsible for conducting on\-the\-job training, in coordination with Shift Supervisors, of new employees assigned to post, or when changes to post orders are made. This may include orientation to the post, review of post orders, routine responsibilities, and how to respond to emergency situations or specific client needs;
* Oversees all reports, logs and pass downs generated by and for the Security Department. Distributes communications and other information to Security Professionals at post as directed
* Manages and supervises all sub\-units within the Security Department, such as fire control room, command center, and loading docks as applicable to job site. May generate work orders and attached paperwork for extra security coverage requests
* Responds to minor incidents (internal to Security Professionals and/or external to client location) that occur, ensuring appropriate action is taken, all reports are properly completed, and appropriate parties are notified in a timely manner
* Identifies any personnel problems occurring at posts, such as payroll issues, employee relations complaints or other concerns, and forward any such issues to Account Manager or Field Supervisor as appropriate. May be responsible for writing a report of the situation or assisting with an investigation, as directed by Account Manager, Branch Manager or Corporate HR Director
* Responsible for making recommendations for counseling and/or disciplinary action, including termination. May be responsible for administering counseling or disciplinary actions (may not make or initiate such decisions on his/her own, but may execute such actions at the specific direction of Account Manager with prior approval from Branch/Corporate HR management)
* Responds to client or site emergencies as they arise, including ensuring appropriate communication to Account Manager, Field Supervisor, Branch and/or Regional Manager. Responsible for maintaining positive client/security relationships through frequent tenant/client contact and support
* May occasionally perform Security Professional type job duties on an as\-needed basis by standing post, but under no circumstances to exceed more than 50% of time in any given workweek.


**QUALIFICATIONS:**


* Minimum high school diploma or equivalent
* Minimum three (3\) – five (5\) years of professional\-level experience required. Prior experience in the security industry, law enforcement and/or military required
* Must possess a valid state Guard License, or have applied and subsequently be issued such a license prior to employment. As a condition of employment, employee must successfully complete a background investigation and a post\-offer/pre\-employment drug/alcohol test. Additionally, as a condition of continued employment, employee must maintain current active status of Guard License at all times, and must carry the license at all times while on duty
* Driving Positions: must possess a valid Driver’s License with at least one year of driving experience, a clean driving record (no major violations within last 36 months, no more than 1 accident in last 24 months, no more than one minor moving violation in last 24 months), a minimum level of insurance as required by Company policy, and the ability to safely operate a vehicle required.
* Energetic and focused personality with a demonstrated ability to take initiative, successfully handle and prioritize multiple competing assignments and effectively manage deadlines. Demonstration of strong customer service orientation required, with ability to effectively resolve client issues in a professional and service\-focused manner and to de\-escalate situations before they become hostile or unpleasant required
* Professional, articulate and able to use good independent judgment and discretion
* Ability to train and coach others, and to effectively enforce post orders, security standards and company policies equitably and consistently
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills required. Ability to successfully interact at all levels of the organ

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager, AWS Enterprise Support, Strategic Industries
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  

  

Would you like to join one of the fastest\-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes including Automotive, Financial Services, Energy, Big Data, and more gain the best value and service from AWS? At AWS Enterprise Support we’re looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application\-level services, Networking, Serverless and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start\-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.  

The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer’s environment for troubleshooting customer support issues, rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB \& RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more.  

Your technical acumen and customer\-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade\-offs, support and risk management.  

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy and resilient. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.
  

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!  

  

  

  

About the team  

About AWS  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3\) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer\-facing environment as a technical lead

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. A3 Consulting is seeking a Project Manager to lead day\-to\-day operations for an enterprise performance and analytics team. If you excel at leading staff responsible for maintaining governance, quality, and risk controls essential for reliable execution, this role is for you!
**In this job you will:**
* Manage the daily and weekly operating rhythm for the delivery team.
* Coordinate the integrated master schedule, deliverable calendar, status updates, and dependency tracking; identify missed inputs, approaching deadlines, and recovery needs.
* Prepare governance agendas and read\-aheads, maintain decision and action logs, track assigned owners, due dates, and objective closure evidence.
* Maintain a proactive risk register using probability\-and\-impact scoring; distinguish risks from realized issues and track mitigation actions, escalation triggers, and residual exposure.
* Convert client priorities and leadership direction into executable tasks, owners, due dates, dependencies, and deliverable milestones.
* Coordinate with team members to collect, validate, organize, and package inputs for client\-facing deliverables.

* Track client comments, maintain comment disposition, coordinate revisions, and ensure deliverables move through review to acceptance.

* Coordinate with schedule, dashboard, risk, resource, and reporting analysts to keep all products aligned and current.
* Identify delivery risks, quality issues, resource constraints, and schedule impacts early, and recommend corrective actions to the Program Manager.

**Required Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Administration, Finance, Data/Analytics, or a related field.
* 8\+ years of federal project management, PMO, delivery management, or operations coordination experience.
* Experience managing CDRLs, status reporting, action logs, decision logs, quality reviews, and comment resolution.
* Experience supporting transition, knowledge transfer, artifact inventories, repository setup, and continuity planning.
* Strong writing, organization, facilitation, stakeholder\-management, and follow\-up skills.
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate across technical, analytical, reporting, and management functions.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, short suspense timelines, and multiple deliverables without losing quality discipline.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
Counterpart: Value\-based care, at the point of care.



At Counterpart Health, we are transforming healthcare and improving patient care with our innovative primary care tool, Counterpart Assistant. By supporting Primary Care Physicians (PCPs), we are able to deliver improved outcomes to our patients at a lower cost through early diagnosis and longitudinal care management of chronic conditions.



We are hiring an Implementation Manager on the Counterpart Assistant team. In this role, you will lead the customer\-facing work of bringing new provider practices and TINs from late\-stage prospects through successful launch on Counterpart Assistant. You will partner closely with account management to hand off new customers, own the customer relationship through implementation, and drive each launch to completion on time and at quality.



You will independently lead multiple concurrent implementations and the cross\-functional work that makes each launch happen. Partnering with account management, support, product, and engineering internally and with providers, office managers, and clinical leads on the customer side: you will drive accountability across every stakeholder and deliver results through influence. Beyond running individual launches, you will help shape the implementation playbook itself — identifying what slows launches down, proposing changes, and driving improvements that reduce time\-to\-launch and lift customer satisfaction. Strong project management fundamentals, clear customer communication, working knowledge of clinical data, and technical fluency will let you keep complex, multi\-stakeholder launches on track.


### **As an Implementation Manager, you will:**


* Own the customer relationship through implementation: you are the primary point of contact for the customer's technical implementation from project kickoff to post go live steady state.
* Lead end\-to\-end project plans for multiple concurrent, multi\-step implementations, keeping internal and customer teams aligned on scope, timeline, and status.
* Partner cross\-functionally with account management, support, product, and engineering to unblock issues, coordinate handoffs, and keep implementations moving on schedule.
* Own the outcomes of each implementation: surface risks early, drive resolution across teams, and hold each launch accountable to its target date and quality bar.
* Apply technical judgment to monitor and address potential integration issues that arise during implementations, working alongside product and engineering to ensure a successful integration and product launch.
* Drive continuous improvement of the implementation process: define and refine the playbook, tooling, and templates that reduce time\-to\-launch and raise the quality bar for every customer experience.

jobs.description:
**About Assembly Software**
Assembly Software is the team behind Neos, the case management platform purpose\-built for personal injury law firms, with embedded intelligence that already knows your cases. We're trusted by 1,100 firms and 15,000 users nationwide, backed by more than 40 years of experience in PI case management. As a growing SaaS company with a passionate team, we're building software that makes cases easier to manage and outcomes better for the firms and clients who rely on it.


When you join Assembly Software, you’re joining a team that genuinely cares about you, your career, and your excitement about your job. When you work for a tech company in the legal field, there are endless opportunities ripe for disruption, and you’ll be on the forefront of that innovation. We want you to pursue what drives you and push your boundaries! Assembly Software is where people come to shake up a historically buttoned\-up industry. **Vision Statement**
Assembly's vision is to provide the legal community the best practice management software that enables client advocacy from anywhere at anytime. **Mission Statement**
Our mission is to provide intuitive and comprehensive legal practice management solutions enhancing efficiency and profitability for our customers. **Core Values*** We are Accountable: We accept responsibility for our choices and actions. We value transparency \+ feedback.
* We Never Stop Learning: We pursue growth \+ learning.
* We Thrive as a Team: We value others' opinions \+ work respectfully with one another.
* We are Collaborative Innovators: We are adventurous, creative \+ open\-minded.
* We are Here to Be of Service to our Customer \+ our Colleagues: No matter our role, we are all here to be of service \+ add value.
* We have Unyielding Integrity: We do the right thin, even when no one is watching.
* We Embrace Diversity \+ Inclusion: We are passionate about creating and cultivating an inclusive culture that promotes and values diversity.
  

As our People Operations Manager at Assembly Software, you'll own the operational core of how Assembly hires, pays and supports its people. This is a growth\-track role. We're hiring the person we expect to become our Director of Employee Operations and who will grow with our organization.

**What You'll Do**


You'll run payroll, benefits and HR operations, and own onboarding and offboarding end to end. You'll lead recruiting for every role below Director level, with recruiter support that can flex up and down with demand. On employee relations and performance management, you'll partner closely with our EVP, Human Resources: you handle policy questions, everyday concerns and performance documentation, higher\-risk matters stay with the EVP, and that line moves as trust builds. Once the core runs smoothly, you'll map our people processes, fix what slows them down, and lead the rollout of the tools that support them.

**What You'll Bring**


You have four to seven or more years in HR or People Operations, with hands\-on experience running payroll and benefits and owning full\-cycle recruiting, not just scheduling. You have sound judgment on employee relations and know what to handle yourself and what to raise. You spot broken processes and fix them, you already use AI as a working tool, and you want a bigger role while understanding that the fundamentals are how you earn it.

**Why Now**


Our foundation is strong and our direction is clear. What we need now is an operator who keeps the core running cleanly while building the systems that let us grow without adding headcount to run them. The processes you build in your first year will shape how every future Assembly employee is hired, paid and supported.

 **When you’re considering a new job, it’s normal to have questions. Here are a few things we get asked all of the time:** **1\. I'm tired of the daily commute. Where are you located?**  

Assembly Software is a fully remote company. We work across time zones and connect through Teams, so you can build your career from wherever you do your best work: home office, favorite coffee shop, or yes, in your PJs if that's your vibe.

 **2\. What makes Assembly Software different?**  

Our people. We're a fast growing SaaS company and the leading provider of case management solutions for personal injury and legal firms. Through our three brands, Neos, Needles, and TrialWorks, we serve over 2,500 law firms and 40,000\+ users, the largest user base in the industry. Backed by Ridge Road Partners since 2017, we combine decades of legal tech expertise with a scrappy, entrepreneurial energy. We move fast, we care about the product, and we have fun doing it. Our sales team also enjoys uncapped commission with built in accelerators, so top performers are rewarded for their impact.

 **3\. What's the benefits package like?**  

Competitive and comprehensive. You'll have access to:

* Medical, dental, and vision plans
* Short and long term disability coverage
* Supplemental insurance options
* 401(k)
* Flexible time off
* Paid parental leave
* An Employee Assistance Program


We invest in our people because we know our results depend on them. When you do great work here, you'll be recognized and rewarded for it.

jobs.title: Project Manager – Data Center & Cloud Infrastructure
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

Edge Node, Inc. is building out multi\-site data center and cloud infrastructure across the U.S., and we need a hands\-on Project Manager to keep equipment, vendors, and sites moving in sync. You'll confirm Bills of Materials (BoMs) and delivery dates with OEM vendors, coordinate the contractors and suppliers delivering power infrastructure (UPS, PDUs, generators, switchgear), and work with our tower partners to decide which sites get provisioned based on available power and space. This role reports directly to the Chief Operating Officer. Remote (U.S.), with strong preference for candidates in the Dallas–Fort Worth area.

**Duties**

* Review, validate, and confirm BoMs with OEM vendors for all project equipment; keep BoM documentation and change logs current
* Track ship dates and delivery windows with OEMs and distributors and flag schedule risks early
* Act as the primary coordination point across OEMs, electrical contractors, equipment suppliers, and logistics providers so equipment is procured, delivered, and installed on schedule
* Drive procurement and delivery of power infrastructure (PDUs, UPS systems, generators, switchgear, transformers, busway, batteries) to meet each site's power requirements
* Build and maintain project schedules across multiple concurrent site deployments, including milestones, dependencies, and critical\-path items
* Coordinate engineering, facilities, IT operations, and finance/procurement on scope, budget, and timeline
* Work with facilities and electrical teams to align each site's power capacity plan with equipment deliveries; track power, cooling, space, and connectivity requirements per site
* Partner with tower partners to evaluate candidate sites, coordinate site surveys and resource assessments, and prioritize which locations to provision
* Maintain a site\-selection tracker showing resource availability, provisioning status, and partner commitments
* Produce status reports and dashboards giving leadership visibility into vendor commitments, BoM status, delivery timelines, risks, and blockers
* Support purchase order creation, invoice reconciliation, budget tracking, and evaluation of vendor quotes for cost, lead time, and technical fit
* Identify ways to streamline vendor coordination and BoM confirmation for future site rollouts

**Requirements**

* 2–5 years of project management or project coordination experience, ideally in data center, IT infrastructure, construction, or technology deployment
* Direct experience working with OEM vendors, equipment suppliers, or manufacturers, including reviewing BoMs and confirming delivery timelines
* Strong organizational skills; able to manage multiple vendors, timelines, and deliverables at once
* Excellent written and verbal communication with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Working knowledge of project management tools (Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Asana, Jira, or similar)
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for tracking BoMs, budgets, and schedules
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* Ability to travel to data center locations as needed (estimated 10–20%, depending on project phase)

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with data center power infrastructure (UPS, PDUs, generators, switchgear) and build/commissioning processes
* Exposure to cloud infrastructure deployment or migration projects
* PMP, CAPM, or similar certification, or actively pursuing one
* Experience with procurement processes, purchase orders, and basic vendor contract terms
* Familiarity with tower/colocation partners or telecom site acquisition and site\-selection processes
* Based in the Dallas–Fort Worth, Texas metro area

**What Success Looks Like**

* Tower sites identified and prioritized based on infrastructure, space, and power
* BoMs confirmed accurately and on time with every OEM vendor
* Vendor delivery schedules tracked proactively, with risks flagged well before they affect site timelines
* Equipment arrives on\-site aligned with each location's power capacity plan, keeping the buildout on schedule
* Leadership has clear, timely visibility into project status, risks, and vendor commitments

Edge Node, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

Pay: $80,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Remote

**About the Company**  

Founded in 2010, Eagle Creek Renewable Energy (ECRE) acquires, enhances, and operates hydroelectric power facilities across the United States. Today, Eagle Creek owns and operates 85 facilities across 18 states, with a nearly 700 MW portfolio that provides reliable, low\-carbon power to more than 260,000 homes.  

  

Eagle Creek is committed to creating long\-term value for its stakeholders and the communities it serves through a focus on safety, integrity, innovation, diversity, and stewardship. Through strategic investments, operational excellence, and continued growth, the company aims to expand its renewable energy platform and play a meaningful role in the transition to a cleaner, more sustainable energy future.

In this role, you will serve as the single point of accountability, bridging cross\-functional inputs, and owning the qualification work and the evidence set that makes each facility’s credits defensible.

* Adaptability: Ability to adjust to changing priorities, processes, or business needs.
* Accountability: Ability to take ownership of responsibilities and deliver expected results.
* Customer/Service Orientation: Ability to understand and respond effectively to customer or stakeholder needs.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**SolvOne is expanding our Project Team!**


SolvOne is seeking an experienced Fuels Project Manager to manage underground storage tank (UST) replacements and related fuel\-system construction projects across multiple locations. This position will oversee projects from initial planning and site coordination through construction, startup, and closeout. The Fuels Project Manager will serve as a central point of coordination between customers, contractors, equipment vendors, regulatory agencies, A\&E firms, and other project stakeholders to help ensure projects are completed safely, compliantly, on schedule, and in accordance with the approved scope of work.

***Responsibilities***

* Manage underground storage tank replacement and related petroleum construction projects from planning through completion and closeout.
* Review project scope, site information, drawings, schedules, contractor proposals, and other project documentation to identify requirements and potential project risks.
* Coordinate project activities with customer representatives, general contractors, petroleum contractors, environmental consultants, equipment vendors, and other stakeholders.
* Coordinate permitting, inspections, testing, and regulatory requirements associated with UST and fuel\-system construction projects.
* Track project schedules, milestones, dependencies, and critical activities to help ensure projects remain on schedule.
* Coordinate site shutdowns, tank removal and installation activities, piping and fueling\-system work, testing, inspections, startup, and return\-to\-service activities as applicable.
* Monitor contractor progress and follow up on open issues, delays, deficiencies, and outstanding deliverables.
* Review field conditions and project changes and coordinate resolution of scope, schedule, or construction issues.
* Compare completed work against approved plans, scopes of work, and customer requirements.
* Develop and maintain punch lists and track outstanding items through completion.
* Maintain accurate project records, schedules, status reports, issue logs, photographs, permits, inspection documentation, and closeout records.
* Provide regular project updates to customers and internal stakeholders, including schedule status, open issues, risks, and required decisions.
* Escalate issues that may affect safety, regulatory compliance, cost, schedule, or successful project completion.
* Manage multiple projects in different phases and geographic locations simultaneously.
* Conduct or participate in site visits, construction meetings, project walks, punch walks, and final inspections as required.
* Coordinate travel efficiently to support assigned projects.
* Follow all customer safety, confidentiality, documentation, and site\-access requirements.

***Qualifications***

* Project management experience within the petroleum, fueling, UST, or retail fuel construction industry required.
* Direct experience managing underground storage tank replacement, tank modification, fuel\-system construction, or major petroleum equipment projects strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of UST systems and petroleum construction, including tanks, piping, dispensers, sumps, spill containment, leak detection, and associated fueling equipment.
* Familiarity with permitting, inspections, environmental requirements, and regulatory processes associated with UST construction and replacement projects.
* Experience coordinating petroleum contractors, general contractors, environmental consultants, equipment vendors, inspectors, and customer stakeholders.
* Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, site plans, scopes of work, specifications, schedules, and project documentation.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects, locations, contractors, and deadlines.
* Strong project planning, organization, documentation, and follow\-through skills.
* Ability to identify project risks, anticipate potential delays, and drive issues toward resolution.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with field personnel, contractors, customers, and leadership.
* Ability to work independently, make sound decisions, and manage priorities without continuous supervision.
* Proficiency with standard business applications and the ability to learn customer\-specific project management and reporting systems.
* Ability to efficiently manage geographically dispersed projects.

***What else?***

* This is a full\-time, salaried position working regular business hours, M\-F
* Must be based in OH or PA
* Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record required

jobs.title: Senior Clinical Project Manager - CNS
jobs.description:
The Senior Clinical Project Manager (PM) supports/is responsible for the overall project coordination and management of clinical studies, including all project deliverables, from start up through close out activities. This is accomplished by ensuring all projects are completed on\-time and on\-budget within the scope of the client agreements. The PM is responsible for the cross\-functional team’s compliance with project Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Good Clinical Practice (GCP)/International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) guidelines, and other applicable regulations. The PM is also responsible for managing study staff and across department initiatives while maintaining client satisfaction.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Lead the initiation, planning, execution, and closeout of clinical studies, ensuring adherence to timelines, budgets, and quality standards.
* Serve as a client\-facing representative; coordinate and lead project meetings, develop agendas, and issue meeting minutes.
* Develop and maintain core study documentation including Project Management Plans, Communication Plans, Risk Logs, timelines, and milestone trackers.
* Manage study budgets, proposals, contracts, and out‑of‑scope documentation; support financial tracking and invoicing processes.
* Support start‑up activities including collection of CDAs, feasibility information, budgets, and CTAs; maintain regulatory and study files.
* Coordinate with functional teams to allocate resources and balance workload across the project.
* Identify project risks and delays; implement contingency and risk‑control measures.
* Oversee TMF management to ensure organization, accuracy, and inspection readiness.
* Manage vendors and ensure their deliverables align with study requirements and quality expectations.
* Support preparation of clinical reports and key study documentation.
* Ensure compliance with SOPs, regulatory guidelines, and study\-specific training requirements.
* Perform additional project\-related duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training and experience
* Minimum of 3 years relevant clinical research industry experience
* Project Manager experience commensurate with years in the industry, and sufficient to successfully perform key responsibilities
* Supervisory experience
* Advanced knowledge of GCPs, ICH guidelines, FDA and other applicable regulations.
* Intermediate knowledge of project management techniques
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, Adobe and Project Management software
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work with all levels of management and employees; ability to gain credibility, provide effective customer service, and foster positive working relationships with internal and external stakeholders
* Ability to function independently in a fast\-paced team environment
* Effective verbal and writing skills; English proficiency
* Ability to travel 10\-20%

jobs.title: Financial IT Project Manager (5670)
jobs.description:
SMX is seeking a dynamic and experienced **Project Manager** to lead the implementation of our CFO Control Tower Budget and Spend (BAS) solution for a key federal government client. This role requires a leader who can expertly navigate the complexities of federal financial management projects, ensuring the successful deployment of a cutting\-edge planning and reporting tool built on the SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) platform.



This is a unique and exciting role that allows the right candidate to use their deep understanding of federal budgeting and planning processes to help build our next generation planning application. We are looking for an energetic and creative federal financial business analyst to take our solution to the next level and drive value for our federal customers. You will be working alongside a talented team of designers, developers and budget SMEs to help build, enhance, and roll out our best\-in\-class solution. This is a full\-time position that is 100% remote and will require minimal travel \<20% and requires a Public Trust clearance.


**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities:**



The ideal candidate will be responsible for the entire project lifecycle, from planning and execution to stakeholder management and final delivery. You will serve as the primary point of contact for the client, ensuring that our "Shared Vision. Outcome Assured." motto is realized through meticulous planning, clear communication, and a relentless focus on achieving mission objectives.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Project Leadership: Direct and manage the full lifecycle of the CFO Control Tower BAS implementation project, including scope, schedule, budget, and quality, from initiation to closure.
* Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary liaison between federal client stakeholders, SMX technical teams, and third\-party vendors to ensure clear communication and alignment of project goals.
* Planning \& Execution: Develop and maintain a comprehensive project plan, outlining tasks, timelines, resource allocation, and dependencies. Proactively manage risks and develop mitigation strategies.
* Technical Oversight: While not a hands\-on technical role, maintain a strong understanding of the SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) platform and the functional aspects of the BAS solution to guide the project effectively.
* Team Coordination: Lead a cross\-functional team of business analysts, data engineers, and solution architects, fostering a collaborative environment to break down stovepipes and deliver targeted capabilities.
* Reporting \& Governance: Provide regular, transparent status reports on project progress, risks, and financial health to both client leadership and SMX executive management.
* Quality Assurance: Ensure the final solution meets all client requirements, is delivered on time, within budget, and adheres to the highest standards of quality and federal security protocols.

**Required Skills \& Experience:**


* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Finance, or a related field.
* Minimum of 10 years' experience as a Project Manager leading complex IT or financial system implementations.
* Proven experience managing SAP ERP implementation and upgrade projects, demonstrating strong project management skills and a deep understanding of SAP systems.
* Demonstrated experience managing projects for U.S. Federal Government agencies.
* Strong understanding of the project management lifecycle and methodologies (e.g., PMP, Agile, Hybrid).
* Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage and influence diverse stakeholder groups.
* Must be a US Citizen and have the ability to obtain a Public Trust clearance.


**Desired Skills \& Experience**


* Experience in managing an SAP ERP or SAP EPM project is highly desirable.
* PMP Certification is highly desired.
* Direct experience with SAP solutions, particularly SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) for planning and reporting.
* Familiarity with federal budgeting, financial planning, and reporting processes (e.g., PPBE).
* Previous experience implementing COTS (Commercial Off\-The\-Shelf) or pre\-built software solutions.
* Experience managing projects with a significant data integration or business intelligence component.



\# LI\-SA1



\#CJPOST

  




At SMX®, we are a team of technical and domain experts dedicated to enabling your mission. From priority national security initiatives for the DoD to highly assured and compliant solutions for healthcare, we understand that digital transformation is key to your future success.



We share your vision for the future and strive to accelerate your impact on the world. We bring both cutting edge technology and an expansive view of what's possible to every engagement. Our delivery model and unique approaches harness our deep technical and domain knowledge, providing forward\-looking insights and practical solutions to power secure mission acceleration.



SMX is an Equal Opportunity employer including disabilities and veterans.



Selected applicant may be subject to a background investigation and/or education verification.



SMX does not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization or immigration related support for this position (i.e. H1B, F\-1 OPT, F\-1 STEM OPT, F\-1 CPT, J\-1, TN, E\-2, E\-3, L\-1 and O\-1, or any EADs or other forms of work authorization that require immigration support from an employer).

jobs.title: Project Manager - Freelance
jobs.description:
**BURRELL COMMUNICATIONS GROUP**

Founded in 1971, Burrell Communications Group, or Burrell for short, is a collective of the creatively curious. Everything we do is centered around researching, amplifying, and celebrating culture, all over the world. We always embrace the responsibility of telling the stories that define communities. We are an engine for insatiable ambition, creative audacity, and cultural integrity – moving at light speed towards the future we’ve always dreamed of, powered by the people.

At Burrell, we know our work is stronger when it reflects the brilliance of different backgrounds, perspectives, and lived experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome candidates of all identities to bring their creativity and passion to the team.


**POSITION SUMMARY**

Project Managers at Burrell function as the strategic operational partner for driving projects and workflow organization\-wide. You’ll work closely with cross\-disciplinary teams on the planning, management, and execution of scopes and campaign projects. You’ll serve as a liaison and contact for identifying and coordinating all resources necessary to complete all marketing activities and programs with efficiencies in timing, budget and workflows.  


*Burrell's Freelance Project Manager is a temporary, full\-time contract role anticipated to run from October 19, 2026 through December 31, 2026\. The position requires 40 hours per week and offers a weekly rate equivalent to $60\-$75 per hour, based on experience. This is a fully remote, U.S.\-based role. To support effective collaboration across teams, departments, and clients, Burrell employees are expected to maintain regular working hours of 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM CST, Monday through Friday.*  


**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**
* Brings structure to workflow and drives forward momentum on scopes and projects
* Identifies ways to improve operational efficiency and connects the dots across teams, timelines and systems
* Partners with account leads to define and understand campaign/project scope, goals, and performance metrics
* Develops, manages, and updates project status, workflows, timelines, deliverables, and budgets to ensure clarity and consistency in entity deliverables and timelines
* Works with department leads to assign tasks, responsibilities, and deliverables for all campaigns and projects
* Manages client and internal teams’ expectations and timelines while communicating changes/dependencies promptly to internal and external team members
* Drives teams to move in sync to final delivery and leads internal project meetings/touchpoints to ensure there’s structure, clarity and continuity to workflow
* Balances health of a scope or project by evaluating utilization, budgets and operational efficiencies

  


**QUALIFICATIONS**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Project Management, and/or related field(s)
* 5\+ years of related, client\-facing industry experience managing and facilitating large\-scale, complex projects to meet sometimes aggressive timelines
* Experience in contributing to and executing national marketing campaigns across various channels (broadcast, print, digital, social, experiential, etc)
* Must be able to effectively develop and communicate workflow charts that align with overarching marketing objectives, strategies, and tactics
* Experience in managing efficient and high\-performance\-driven project management processes in a fast\-paced B2C environment, preferably in retail, CPG, and digital sectors, to drive business growth and improved efficiencies
* Strong leadership and client/internal relationship\-building skills at all levels of the organization
* Demonstrated capability to manage complex projects and achieve results promptly and within budget
* Proven ability to influence the efficiency and quality of work, delivering a stronger performance and contributing to a stronger client relationship
* Proven success in managing, collaborating, and working with both internal and external cross\-functional teams to deliver continuous business performance improvement
* Demonstrate excellent writing and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate and present presentations

jobs.title: Marketing Project Manager
jobs.description:
UTTR stands for “up \& to the right.” For us, it resonates on multiple dimensions — it’s the trajectory we envision for our clients and their outcomes, our aspiration for agency growth, and the path we hope every team member carves for their own career.


As a **Marketing Project Manager at UTTR**, you’ll play a key role within our internal marketing team, taking ownership of projects from planning through delivery. You’ll be responsible for keeping projects moving, coordinating cross\-functional teams, managing timelines and priorities, and ensuring that every deliverable meets the right standards.


We’re looking for someone with **3–5 years of project management experience**, ideally within a marketing, creative, or digital agency environment. You’re organized and proactive, but also comfortable getting into the details — reviewing copy and creative, asking the right questions, identifying risks before they become issues, and making sure projects ultimately get across the finish line.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* Own and manage internal marketing projects from initial briefing through final delivery, primarily using ClickUp.
* Build and maintain project timelines, milestones, task dependencies, and priorities.
* Translate marketing objectives into clear project plans, briefs, deliverables, and actionable tasks.
* Assign work to team members and provide clear, detailed briefs and expectations.
* Coordinate with marketing, creative, leadership, and other cross\-functional teams to keep projects aligned and moving forward.
* Proactively identify risks, bottlenecks, and potential delays, and develop solutions to keep projects on track.
* Monitor project progress, timelines, workloads, and dependencies, escalating issues when necessary.
* Review deliverables to ensure they meet project requirements, quality standards, and brand guidelines.
* Review and provide constructive feedback on copywriting, creative assets, and marketing campaigns, using sound marketing judgment to identify what is working and what needs improvement.
* Occasionally write, edit, or refine copy to improve clarity, consistency, and alignment with UTTR’s brand voice.
* Coordinate stakeholder reviews and secure final approvals before deliverables are published or released.
* Schedule and publish approved content across social media platforms while maintaining consistency with brand guidelines.
* Maintain organized project documentation, workflows, and processes within ClickUp.
* Communicate project status, priorities, risks, and next steps clearly to relevant stakeholders.
* Balance multiple projects and competing priorities while maintaining attention to detail and quality.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve project management processes, workflows, and team efficiency.
* Contribute to a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the marketing team.

**Qualifications**
------------------


* **3–5 years of experience in project management**, preferably within a marketing, creative, digital agency, or similar fast\-paced environment.
* Experience managing multiple marketing projects simultaneously from planning through execution.
* Strong understanding of marketing workflows and familiarity with digital marketing concepts and practices.
* Proficiency with project management tools; **ClickUp experience is a plus**.
* Demonstrated ability to manage timelines, priorities, dependencies, and competing deadlines.
* Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to confidently coordinate and collaborate with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving project risks.
* Ability to provide thoughtful, constructive feedback on marketing copy and creative work.
* Strong judgment and ability to make informed decisions while knowing when to involve stakeholders.
* Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of projects and outcomes.
* Ability to operate effectively in a remote, distributed team environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field is preferred.

**Working Hours**
-----------------


We don’t care where you work, but you need to be available to work **EST, CST, MST, or PST hours**.


**Why Join UTTR?**
------------------


**Global flexibility:** We’re a fully remote team. Work from anywhere while collaborating with talented people around the world.


**Flexible vacation:** Take time off when you need it and recharge.


**Cultural diversity:** Work alongside a diverse, global team and gain perspectives from people across different backgrounds and markets.


**Recharge days:** We believe sustainable performance requires time to disconnect, reset, and recharge.


**Diverse tech clients:** Work with a variety of innovative startups and technology companies, keeping your work varied and creatively challenging.


*Please be aware that legitimate UTTR recruitment communications will come from an* ***@uttr.com*** *email address. Any offers or candidate interviews originating from other email domains should be treated as potential phishing attempts and do not represent UTTR LLC.*


*If you are ever unsure about the legitimacy of a communication, please contact UTTR directly.*

jobs.title: Mid Market Program Manager
jobs.description:
Harbor IT is a leading Managed Service Provider (MSP) specializing in delivering cutting edge Cybersecurity, IT, and Cloud Services to a diverse portfolio of clients. We pride ourselves on our commitment to excellence, innovation, and customer satisfaction. Harbor IT is backed by investment firm Worklyn Partners since 2022 and has built a national platform through acquisition and rapid organic growth. Our mission is to manage our clients’ technology and mitigate their cyber risks, so that they don’t have to.

  

The Mid\-Market Program Manager owns the end\-to\-end operational performance of Harbor IT's mid\-market POD: the clients in it, the delivery staff who serve them, the projects running inside it, and the service delivery workflows that hold it together. This is a true operational leadership role. The Program Manager sets the standard, builds the playbook, and holds the team accountable to it. This is a foundational hire. The POD is being stood up ahead of a significant mid\-market client coming online, and the person in this seat is expected to arrive with proven MSP/IT practices and install them, not wait to be handed a process. They will directly manage the POD's Service Delivery Managers, Technical Leads, and support staff; own service quality and SLA attainment; run the POD's PMO and project delivery; own PSA data integrity and the financial inputs of delivery; and carry renewal accountability for the POD book. This role demands a results\-oriented operator: someone who holds the team to timelines, enforces standards without apology, and drives outcomes rather than consensus. We do not want a yes\-man. We want someone who will push back when the work is not up to standard and own the result either way. The metrics at the end of this document are the job, not an appendix to it. **Organizational Structure**
Harbor IT is organized into Practices, which are vertical groupings aligned to client segment: Healthcare, Critical Infrastructure, and Private Equity. Each Practice contains multiple PODs, which are tightly focused delivery units responsible for a defined client set. The POD is the core operating unit of the business. This role leads the mid\-market POD and reports into its Practice.  

The Mid\-Market Program Manager reports directly to the Practice Director, who oversees all PODs within the Practice and is accountable for Practice\-level performance and client retention.  

Each POD also includes a POD\-CIO (virtual CIO, the senior client\-facing executive technology partner) and a CSM (Client Success Manager). Neither reports to the Mid\-Market Program Manager. The POD\-CIO owns executive client relationships, strategic IT roadmaps, and expansion positioning. The CSM handles day\-to\-day client operations and satisfaction. The Program Manager owns renewal execution and a defined renewal target for the POD book, with pricing and discount authority within limits set by leadership, and is jointly accountable with the POD\-CIO for expansion attainment. The Program Manager and POD\-CIO are expected to operate in lockstep, aligned daily on client health, escalations, at\-risk accounts, and service quality. A breakdown in that partnership will surface immediately in client outcomes. **Ownership boundaries:*** Practice Director: Practice\-level performance across all PODs, client retention at the Practice level, and the Program Manager's performance.
* Mid\-Market Program Manager: POD delivery performance, SLA and KPI attainment, the delivery team, the POD's PMO and project outcomes, PSA data integrity, delivery margin inputs, and renewal execution.
* POD\-CIO: Executive client relationships, strategic IT roadmap, technology standards guidance, and expansion positioning.
* CSM: Day\-to\-day client operations, satisfaction signals, and routine client communication.

 **Key Responsibilities:*** Manage and lead the pod's Service Delivery Managers, Technical Leads, and support staff, including hiring, performance management, coaching, and day\-to\-day workload assignment.
* Own service quality for the POD: monitor service levels and enforce compliance with contractual SLAs and KPIs, and define the measurement where it does not yet exist.
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of projects within the pod, including scoping, planning, resourcing, and budget tracking, from kickoff through closeout.
* Own queue health for the POD: ticket aging, backlog disposition, escalation rates, reopen rates, and first contact resolution. Review the backlog weekly and disposition every aged ticket.
* Own PSA hygiene for the POD: enforce ticket quality standards (notes, categorization, resolution documentation), time entry accuracy and timeliness, and correct work type classification. The Program Manager is accountable if the data in the PSA is wrong.
* Own the financial inputs of POD delivery: drive delivery staff utilization to target, enforce 95 percent or better time entry accuracy, manage agreement utilization, identify out\-of\-scope billing opportunities, and ensure contract compliance. This role directly impacts service margin.
* Build and maintain service delivery SOPs, escalation playbooks, ticket handling standards, and onboarding documentation for the POD. This role is expected to create operational structure, not inherit it.
* Analyze ticketing and incident trends, identify root causes, and drive remediation through proactive service improvement, delivering a defined number of CSI (continual service improvement) actions each quarter.
* Own client communication during major incidents, planned maintenance, and other impactful events, and own the post\-incident RCA and follow\-through on corrective actions.
* Maintain a current performance scorecard for every direct report, with individual metrics that ladder up to POD\-level KPIs, and conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and accountability conversations.
* Serve as the leader of PMO for the pod, establishing and enforcing consistent project man

The company’s product portfolio includes a broad array of water treatment chemistries, process aids, functional additives, cleaners, disinfectants, and state\-of\-the\-art monitoring, control and delivery systems. These technologies are used by customers to improve operational efficiencies, enhance product quality, protect plant assets, minimize environmental impact, and create cleaner and safer environments. Headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware, the company has 78 manufacturing facilities strategically located around the globe and employs a team of over \~23000 professionals in \>160 countries across six continents. Solenis is a 2025 Best Managed Company Gold Standard honoree.


For additional information about Solenis, please visit www.solenis.com or follow us on social media.

* Competitive health \+ wellness benefit plan
* Continuous professional development with many opportunities for growth!
* Recharge with 15 days of paid time off

 **Position Summary**

You are responsible for leading and supporting capital projects across the North American plant network. You will provide project leadership from initial planning and budgeting through execution, commissioning, and closeout, while ensuring projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in alignment with business objectives. You will provide leadership and guidance to Project Managers and Engineers, support the planning, tracking, forecasting, and budgeting of Capital Expenditures (CapEx), and ensure projects progress effectively through the established Stage Gate process in the multi\-million\-dollar range.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Lead medium to large\-scale capital projects from concept and feasibility through design, construction, commissioning, and project closeout.
* Develop and maintain project scope, schedules, budgets, resource plans, and execution strategies.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary project teams, including Engineering, Operations, EHS, Finance, Procurement, R\&D, and other functional stakeholders.

* Serve as a resource and mentor to Project Managers, Engineers, and other project team members.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives related to capital planning, project execution, cost management, and reporting.
* Facilitate effective communication between plant leadership, project teams, Finance, Engineering, and senior management.
* Prepare and present project updates and portfolio\-level information to leadership.

 **Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Project Management, Business, Finance, or a related technical discipline preferred.
* 10\+ years of experience managing capital projects in a manufacturing, industrial, or similar environment.
* Extensive working knowledge of capital project processes, including budgeting, forecasting, project accounting, and general accounting policies and procedures.
* Strong understanding of project cost management, forecasting, scheduling, and financial reporting.
* Strong understanding of construction and engineering principles.
* Ownership of Safe work environment for projects.
* Experience with Microsoft Office and SAP.
* Experience working with multidisciplinary teams and managing projects across multiple sites.

Ability to travel 50\-80%  
*

So, if you are interested in working for a world\-class company and enjoy solving complex challenges, whether in the lab or the field, consider joining our team.*

All* *qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.*
