new_jobs.title: Program Manager, Safeguards Workforce Operations
new_jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------



Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------



Anthropic’s Safeguards Enforcement team detects and mitigates misuse of Claude, and much of that work depends on people: a growing human review workforce made up of full\-time staff, contractors, vendors and BPO partners. As that workforce scales across a widening range of harm areas, the programs that bring people in, give them the right access, and roll them off cleanly have to keep pace.



As Program Manager for Safeguards Workforce Operations, you’ll own those programs end to end. You’ll run onboarding, offboarding, device provisioning and access provisioning for every worker type we use, working hands\-on with the requests themselves while you build the processes that make them repeatable. You’ll partner with Enforcement leads to turn shifting priorities into capacity plans, and carry those plans through with our vendor partners. Because this role supports every Safeguards Enforcement program, you’ll also connect the dots across Anthropic, working with IT, People Operations, Security, Contingent Workforce, Human Data Operations and other teams running scaled human review to streamline practices and keep standards consistent.



This is a role for someone who likes fixing broken things at speed. The landscape moves quickly, priorities change often, and the work is an even mix of direct execution and program building.


**Key responsibilities**
------------------------


* Own the workforce lifecycle for contractor, vendor and BPO reviewers: onboarding, offboarding, device provisioning and access provisioning
* Triage and execute inbound requests for new or changing vendor, BPO and contractor capacity
* Turn ad hoc or broken processes into scalable ones, with clear owners, service levels and a system of record
* Partner with IT and Security on access governance: least\-privilege provisioning, timely revocation and regular access reviews
* Build and maintain capacity plans with Enforcement leads, translating review demand into workforce needs and adjusting as priorities shift
* Work with Safeguards vendor management to hold partners accountable to capacity and onboarding commitments
* Align practices with Human Data Operations and other teams running scaled human review, and help them streamline their own workflows
* Help define the long\-term workforce strategy for Safeguards Enforcement

**Minimum qualifications**
--------------------------


* Have personally run onboarding, offboarding, access and device provisioning for contractor, vendor or BPO workforces — doing the work, not only overseeing it
* Have operated scaled human review programs with vendors or BPOs, such as trust \& safety, content moderation or data annotation operations
* Have taken a broken or ad hoc process, made it scalable, and brought other teams along in adopting it
* Understand the fundamentals of capacity planning: how volume, handle time, quality targets, ramp and attrition turn into workforce needs
* Exercise sound judgment on access and permissions, and know when to bring in IT or Security
* Move quickly and stay effective when priorities change and information is incomplete
* Build alignment through direct partnership with the teams you depend on

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------


* Owned a vendor or BPO relationship directly, including service levels and business reviews
* Built formal capacity models for review or operations workforces
* Supported workforces across more than one enforcement or harm area
* Hands\-on experience with device management and identity and access tooling
* Worked through a period of hypergrowth where programs had to mature alongside the organization

$245,000 \- $285,000 USD

new_jobs.title: Project Manager - Service
new_jobs.description:
The Service Project Manager (SPM) role involves overseeing multiple project lifecycles, from initial cost estimation to completion, for HVAC/plumbing installations, service projects, and large\-scale repairs. The ideal candidate will have a solid background in HVAC system operations, strong project management expertise, and the ability to ensure cost\-effective solutions while maintaining high\-quality standards.


**Responsibilities**

* Analyze project requirements and customer needs to develop accurate cost estimates for HVAC service work, including repairs, replacements, and retrofits.
* Review drawings, specifications, and other documents to determine project scope and material requirements.
* Collaborate with service technicians, project managers, and sales teams to ensure estimates align with operational capabilities, and customer expectations.
* Actively manage/mentor support personnel under your direct report (if applicable).
* Obtain and evaluate multiple vendor quotes for equipment, materials, and subcontractor services to ensure cost\-effective solutions.
* Prepare comprehensive proposals that outline labor, materials, and overhead costs, ensuring alignment with company pricing strategies and industry standards.
* Communicate with customers to clarify project details, answer questions, and provide recommendations to optimize system performance and cost efficiency.
* Track and manage bid deadlines, revisions, and approvals, ensuring timely and accurate submission of estimates.
* Oversee post\-estimate project handoff, providing clear scope, schedule \& budget details to field personnel and service teams.
* Manage HVAC service projects from planning to completion, ensuring on\-time and on\-budget delivery.
* Coordinate with labor force leadership to ensure seamless project execution.
* Monitor project progress, managing any challenges to maintain efficiency and quality standards.
* Manage multiple projects and bid opportunities simultaneously.
* Utilize company CRM, bid, and project management platforms.
* Create a detailed schedule that aligns with customer expectations, equipment lead times, and field team availability.
* Communicate with customers throughout the project lifecycle, providing updates, ensuring satisfaction, and addressing concerns.
* Ensure compliance with safety regulations, industry standards, and company policies.
* Oversee procurement of materials, equipment, and labor resources for assigned projects.
* Track project costs and manage profitability, adjusting as necessary to stay within budget.
* Maintain accurate documentation, including contracts, change orders, and project reports.
* Prepare required closeout package.
* Stay informed about industry trends, new technologies, and best practices to improve service operations.
* Coordinate with Area Supervisors and Foremen to schedule projects, maintenance, and repairs efficiently.
* Drive personal sales goals.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in engineering (mechanical, industrial, etc. ), Construction Management, or related field experience.
* 5\-7 or more years work experience project engineering in HVAC, MEP, or construction.
* Extensive knowledge of HVAC systems, plumbing, ductwork, piping, refrigeration, and energy efficiency solutions.
* Deep understanding of HVAC and plumbing systems, service processes, and industry standards.
* Digitally savvy, including excellent PC application skills and the ability to quickly learn numerous custom software applications.
* Proficiency in estimating and project management software (e.g.,Procore, Bluebeam, Fast Pipe, \& Fast Duct).
* Familiarity with HVAC load calculations and system design.

**Skills**

* Excellent communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to clearly convey information to customers, technicians, vendors, and management.
* Active listening to understand client needs and field concerns.
* Strong attention to detail and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong written communication for proposals, reports, and documentation.
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
* Conflict resolution skills to handle workplace challenges.
* Ability to negotiate contracts, pricing, and timelines with vendors and subcontractors.
* Ability to review performance and identify improvement strategy.
* Eagerness to learn, take initiative, and grow professionally within the field.
* Ability to travel occasionally to project sites and work in a team environment.
* Delegation and accountability to ensure efficiency in project execution.
* Persuasive communication to secure approvals and sell service solutions.
* Ensuring accuracy in cost estimates, documentation, and compliance with regulations.


An effective and successful Service Project Manager is a highly organized and detail\-oriented professional who excels in overseeing HVAC service projects, ensuring they are completed on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. They possess a strong combination of technical knowledge, leadership skills, and customer service expertise.

We provide equal opportunity to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, special disabled veteran, marital status, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.*

new_jobs.description:
Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Mountain View, CA, USA; New York, NY, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of program management experience within design or UX organizations.
* Experience with UX related projects and UX design, user research, or user centered development tools and methodologies.
* Experience in consumer product organizations.
* Experience managing and scaling horizontal programs across cross\-functional teams.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with the product development life\-cycle.
* Experience analyzing data and leveraging insights to drive strategy.
* Experience managing risks (e.g. operational, product, team health).

**About the job**
-----------------


At Google, we "Focus on the user and all else will follow." UX Programs \& Operations drives projects by increasing communication, streamlining the UX design process, and fostering a culture of user\-centered development. You will join our multi\-disciplinary UX team, collaborating with Engineering and Product Management, to create industry\-leading products based on user insights.  

  

As a UX Program Manager, you will combine expert project management with a passion for user experience to improve the design of products used by billions. Your role is to plan projects, define milestones, assess risks, create actionable insights, and ensure deadlines are met. You will harmonize the work of various UX disciplines and cross\-functional partners to drive team objectives and create innovative experiences.



As a UX Program Manager across both the Agentic and Discover and Explore UX pillars (DEUX), you will partner with UX Research and cross\-functional leads to scale impactful programs, land insights into product strategy and roadmaps and establish clear team operational rhythms.


In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $159000 \- $230000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Provide leadership and operational excellence across UX teams to deliver the highest level of trust\-building and strategic counsel through all project interactions, while building strong collaborative relationships with appropriate stakeholders across program work.
* Develop business cases and engagement with partners on continuous improvements and optimizations, creating measurable, scalable, and repeatable processes/tools that drive seamless cross\-functional collaborations/handoffs.
* Run and implement analytical efforts for broader or cross\-functional projects, programs, and strategies.
* Contribute to the definition, integration and reporting of key UX metrics that drive a culture of user\-centered development based on program needs and stakeholder input.
* Manage large, complex programs while turning chaos into an efficient organization.

**Company Description**  

Veolia has acquired Clean Earth. As Clean Earth completes its integration into Veolia, recruiting and hiring for this role is being managed in partnership with the Clean Earth talent acquisition team.


Veolia in North America is the top\-ranked environmental company in the United States for three consecutive years, and the country’s largest private water operator and technology provider as well as hazardous waste and pollution treatment leader. It offers a full spectrum of water, waste, and energy management services, including water and wastewater treatment, commercial and hazardous waste collection and disposal, energy consulting and resource recovery.


Veolia helps commercial, industrial, healthcare, higher education and municipality customers throughout North America. Headquartered in Boston, Veolia has more than 10,000 employees working at more than 350 locations across North America.

 **Job Description**  

The Onsite Project Manager will work full\-time at a customer location, with responsibility to supervise and coordinate all activities for the receipt and shipment of hazardous waste materials in accordance with applicable Federal, State, and local regulations and company policies, practices and procedures. This position will execute environmental compliance tasks to support the customer’s environmental plans, permits and programs. The primary responsibilities will be management and disposal of hazardous and non\-hazardous wastes.

* Acts as daily point of contact with customer and outside entities for environmental compliance activities
* Monitor waste accumulation areas, assisting as needed with identification, segregation, profiling, labeling and staging
* Assist with waste characterization of various waste streams
* Supervise, plan and schedule all work activities related to receipt and shipping of waste ensuring internal deadlines are met
* Work with on\-site teams daily to monitor waste and recycling programs and maintain swaps and pickups as needed.
* Prepare and provide of customer data, metrics and/or reports as required
* Internally support and monitor customer requirements, to ensure Key Performance Indicators (KPI’s) are met/exceeded
* Facilitate and conduct compliance inspections at the customer location and implement corrective actions based on results of compliance inspections
* Coordinate incoming waste and outbound loads including managing paperwork
* Conduct Safety Meetings to ensure that all employees comply with all job safe operating procedures including equipment maintenance.
* Ensure a clean and orderly work area is maintained at all times, proper chemical storage, proper labeling and handling techniques, and proper use of personal protective equipment
* Provide production reports to management
* Supervise the direct shipping, receiving, packaging, and processing of hazardous waste materials in compliance with standard operational procedures and regulatory requirements
* Supervise sampling for waste stream identification and perform spot testing to assure safe and appropriate consolidation of waste streams
* Supervise segregation, transfer and compacting procedures according to company policies, job safe practices, and quality assurance guidelines, and correct any deficiencies
* Maintain compliance with all applicable regulatory requirements
* Report and respond to plant emergencies as needed in accordance with the Contingency Plan.
* Makes recommendations and/or approvals on salary adjustments, promotions, transfers, and dismissals within their assigned areas.
* Promotes Safety and Security initiatives across the entire team within their assigned areas.
* **Performs other related duties and/or project work as required or requested.**

**Work Environment**

* Willingness and ability to work in a hands\-on manner to execute key initiatives and activities.
* Must be willing and able to abide by Clean Earth’s Core Values and Code of Conduct.
* Required to wear company\-provided personal protective equipment including eye protection, foot protection, hard hat, Tyvek coveralls, and respirator.
* Willingness and ability to travel via automobile, commercial airline and other public transportation as needed.

  

**Qualifications** **Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in an Environmental/Science or Business\-related field

**Experience:** (*Required minimum of years of relevant experience.)*

  

* Minimum 2 years of relevant industry experience with hazardous waste
* Minimum 3 years of experience in a business or project management\-based role
* Minimum 2 years of managing an operations team.
* 40\-hour Hazwoper and 8\-hour refresher certification

**Skills**: ***(The skills listed are the abilities and knowledge required to perform the job effectively******.)***

* Knowledge of RCRA, DOT, OSHA and DEA Regulations as they relate to waste characterization and the transportation of hazardous waste
* Prior experience with DOT shipping, packaging, and labeling requirements for hazardous waste
* Prior experience reading and interpreting signs, labels, waste documents, manifests, procedures, and regulations
* Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint

  

**Additional Information** **Starting salary \- $95,000 \- $95\.000**


Benefits: Comprehensive benefits package includes paid time off policies, as well as health, dental, vision, life insurance, tuition reimbursement, paid volunteering and more. In addition, commencing no later than January 1, 2027, benefits package will include participation in an employer sponsored 401(k) plan, to save for retirement. Pay and benefits for employees represented by a union are outlined in their collective bargaining agreement.

new_jobs.description:
**Job Description Summary**


‎


Patient Engagement Specialist I supports patient access by performing routine scheduling, call handling, information verification, message routing, and documentation tasks in a centralized or practice\-based patient engagement setting. Assists with appointment scheduling, patient inquiries, demographic updates, insurance information capture, care team message routing, and patient communication under established procedures. Supports accurate patient service and timely access by following approved scripts, workflows, and escalation guidelines.  

  

Patient Engagement Specialist I works under close supervision on clearly defined tasks within established parameters. Decisions are limited in scope and impact own work products. Builds foundational knowledge of patient engagement, scheduling workflows, patient communication standards, electronic medical record documentation, and service procedures through structured assignments with frequent guidance from more experienced team members.

‎

* Answer incoming patient calls, messages, or requests using approved scripts, workflows, and service standards.
* Schedule, cancel, and reschedule appointments according to provider templates, visit type guidelines, and site\-specific scheduling rules.
* Verify patient demographic information, insurance details, contact information, and appointment needs in scheduling and electronic medical record systems.
* Route clinical questions, medication requests, urgent symptoms, and care team messages to the appropriate licensed clinical staff or operational queue.
* Provide routine information to patients regarding appointment preparation, arrival instructions, documentation needs, and standard access processes.
* Document call outcomes, scheduling actions, message routing, and patient communication accurately in designated systems.
* Escalate complex patient concerns, scheduling exceptions, system issues, or service barriers to more experienced staff or leadership.

* Basic knowledge of customer service practices, appointment scheduling, data entry, and patient communication standards.

* Ability to follow scripts, procedures, call handling standards, and escalation guidelines with close guidance.
* Strong verbal communication, listening, accuracy, and service orientation.


Ability to protect confidential information and follow HIPAA, privacy, and information security requirements.


‎

$18\.00
to

new_jobs.title: Partner Enablement Specialist
new_jobs.description:
**Our Story**


Campfire is a next\-gen core accounting platform built for modern mid\-market finance teams. We help them close fast and scale even faster. Our platform replaces outdated legacy ERPs and manual accounting processes with automation\-driven solutions that simplify and accelerate finance workflows. In the past year alone, we have grown 10x, driven by strong customer demand and a product that delivers real results for accounting \& finance teams. We are scaling quickly and building the future of finance by giving teams the clarity, control, and strategic visibility they need to lead with confidence.

**Role Overview**


As Partner Enablement Specialist, your mission is to make sure every external implementation partner can deliver the Campfire standard as reliably as our internal team does. You'll take the training curriculum and standards developed for internal onboarding and adapt them for an external audience — building the certification bootcamps, materials, and ongoing support that keep partners accurate, confident, and self\-sufficient. This is a hands\-on, execution\-focused role: you're not designing the overall onboarding architecture, you're the person who makes sure partners actually learn it, pass it, and keep up with it as the product evolves.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Partner Bootcamp Delivery*

* Run scheduled Partner Bootcamps, adapting the internal onboarding curriculum into partner\-facing training sessions, workshops, and materials.
* Own the partner certification process: administer assessments, track completion, and issue certifications against the rubrics defined by the Product Enablement Manager.
* Maintain a partner\-facing knowledge base (guides, FAQs, troubleshooting docs) that mirrors internal SOPs but is tailored for external use.

*Partner Readiness \& Support*

* Serve as the first point of contact for partner questions during and after certification.
* Monitor partner\-led implementations for early signs of drift from the Campfire standard, and flag recurring issues back to the Product Enablement Manager.
* Collect partner feedback on training gaps, confusing configurations, or product friction, and route it upstream.

*Content Maintenance*

* Keep partner training materials in sync as product changes roll out — update decks, scripts, and guides in real\-time under the direction of the Product Enablement Manager.
* Help build out video modules and self\-serve certification paths as the partner program scales.

*Cross\-Functional Coordination*

* Partner with the Head of Solution Consulting Partnerships and the Accounting Partnerships Lead to coordinate bootcamp logistics — aligning on scheduling, partner cohorts, and readiness timelines for each partnership track.
* Work with the Accounting Partnerships Lead to ensure bootcamp content reflects the specific configurations and workflows accounting partners need to certify on.
* Work with the Head of Solution Consulting Partnerships to align solution consulting partner training with evolving deal and implementation requirements.

**Requirements**

* 1–3 years of experience in implementation, customer success, or training/enablement — ideally with some direct Campfire product exposure.
* Strong communicator who can explain technical configuration steps clearly to an external audience with less context than an internal hire.
* Organized and detail\-oriented: comfortable owning a certification pipeline and tracking who's where in it.
* Comfortable running live sessions (bootcamps, workshops) as well as producing written/video materials.
* This is an execution and delivery role, not a design\-from\-scratch role — success means faithfully scaling what's already been built, not reinventing it.

**ABOUT LEGION HEALTH**
=======================


At Legion Health, we believe everyone deserves fast, affordable, and world\-class health care, and we’re developing the AI infrastructure to deliver it ourselves at world scale.


Legion is building **autonomous medical care** (the AI doctor), starting with psychiatry. Our AI\-native care\-delivery platform currently automates 95% of the administrative work required for us to deliver direct patient care. We also recently became the first company ever to receive regulatory authorization to let AI prescribe psychiatric medications, allowing us to not only collapse health care’s admin costs but also its clinical labor costs—**shifting this industry’s economics from humans to tokens.**


Our technical moat is hard to copy—we combine **rich data, production AI, doctors in the loop, and end\-to\-end care operations** to deliver measurably better care to a clinically complex patient population. This has helped us produce **tens of thousands of total visits in just 2 years**, all while holding ops costs flat and achieving industry\-leading patient NPS and retention. While the last generation of healthcare startups made the existing system incrementally more efficient, Legion is rebuilding full\-stack care delivery from first principles. **Our vision?** A 10X better patient experience that’s higher quality, less expensive, and more scalable than ever before. And a 10X better clinician experience that frees our providers to focus on what matters most: caring for patients.


Legion Health is backed by **Y Combinator,** leading venture capital firms, and founders from Function Health, Modern Health, Everly Health, Trusted Health, Clipboard Health, PatientPing, Sesame Care, Faire, EasyPost, and fuboTV.

new_jobs.description:
**We are:**


Accenture's Life Sciences Reinventive Enterprise practice leads AI\-driven enterprise transformation at the world's leading pharmaceutical and biotechnology organizations. We deploy the Reinvention Force: a human \+ AI team of Transformers, Workforce Architects, and AI \& Data Innovators that makes reinvention real at enterprise scale.  

This is a high\-visibility, high\-impact practice with strong momentum and a clear path to Managing Director for high performers.

 **You are:**


An experienced practitioner with proven delivery expertise in your domain. You are analytically rigorous and structured in your thinking. You communicate complex ideas clearly to senior stakeholders. You are comfortable operating in ambiguous environments and thrive in cross\-functional delivery teams. You have supported business development and are ready to take on more. You bring intellectual curiosity, drive, and a genuine interest in how AI is transforming the Life Sciences industry.

  

The Learning \& Development Partner designs and delivers role\-specific training for redesigned roles within the pod's functional scope. This role builds the training curriculum, coordinates delivery alongside each AI release, and measures learning effectiveness to ensure the organization is ready to operate in new ways.

 **The work:**

* Design and deliver role\-specific training for redesigned roles within the pod's functional scope
* Build the training curriculum and coordinate delivery alongside each new technology and AI agent release
* Translate process and role redesigns into practical, accessible learning content for functional audiences
* Measure training effectiveness and learner adoption — adjust curriculum based on feedback and adoption data
* Collaborate with the Workforce Design Lead and change management team to align training with the overall change plan.
* Travel varies by client needs and could be up to 80%

  

**Here’s what you need:**

  

Candidates must have at least 5 years of combined experience in the following:

  

* Instructional design, curriculum development, or enterprise learning in a consulting or corporate environment
* Designing role\-based training programs for technology or process transformation programs
* Experience with digital training delivery platforms and learning management systems (Cornerstone, Workday Learning, or equivalent)
* Ability to translate technical process and role changes into practical, accessible learning content for non\-technical audiences
* Experience measuring training effectiveness with data\-driven curriculum refinement

 **Bonus points if you have:**

  

* ATD, CPTD, or equivalent instructional design certification
* Experience using AI\-generated content tools to accelerate training curriculum development and personalization
* Background in Life Sciences regulatory or compliance training design
* Familiarity with AI\-enabled learning platforms and adaptive learning technologies
* Experience coordinating training delivery across multiple simultaneous technology releases

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  

  

Would you like to join one of the fastest\-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes including Automotive, Financial Services, Energy, Big Data, and more gain the best value and service from AWS? At AWS Enterprise Support we’re looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application\-level services, Networking, Serverless and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start\-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.  

The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer’s environment for troubleshooting customer support issues, rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB \& RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more.  

Your technical acumen and customer\-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade\-offs, support and risk management.  

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy and resilient. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.
  

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!  

  

  

  

About the team  

About AWS  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

------------------------

* 3\+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3\) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree

----------------------------

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer\-facing environment as a technical lead

new_jobs.title: Implementation Manager
new_jobs.description:
Counterpart: Value\-based care, at the point of care.



At Counterpart Health, we are transforming healthcare and improving patient care with our innovative primary care tool, Counterpart Assistant. By supporting Primary Care Physicians (PCPs), we are able to deliver improved outcomes to our patients at a lower cost through early diagnosis and longitudinal care management of chronic conditions.



We are hiring an Implementation Manager on the Counterpart Assistant team. In this role, you will lead the customer\-facing work of bringing new provider practices and TINs from late\-stage prospects through successful launch on Counterpart Assistant. You will partner closely with account management to hand off new customers, own the customer relationship through implementation, and drive each launch to completion on time and at quality.



You will independently lead multiple concurrent implementations and the cross\-functional work that makes each launch happen. Partnering with account management, support, product, and engineering internally and with providers, office managers, and clinical leads on the customer side: you will drive accountability across every stakeholder and deliver results through influence. Beyond running individual launches, you will help shape the implementation playbook itself — identifying what slows launches down, proposing changes, and driving improvements that reduce time\-to\-launch and lift customer satisfaction. Strong project management fundamentals, clear customer communication, working knowledge of clinical data, and technical fluency will let you keep complex, multi\-stakeholder launches on track.


### **As an Implementation Manager, you will:**


* Own the customer relationship through implementation: you are the primary point of contact for the customer's technical implementation from project kickoff to post go live steady state.
* Lead end\-to\-end project plans for multiple concurrent, multi\-step implementations, keeping internal and customer teams aligned on scope, timeline, and status.
* Partner cross\-functionally with account management, support, product, and engineering to unblock issues, coordinate handoffs, and keep implementations moving on schedule.
* Own the outcomes of each implementation: surface risks early, drive resolution across teams, and hold each launch accountable to its target date and quality bar.
* Apply technical judgment to monitor and address potential integration issues that arise during implementations, working alongside product and engineering to ensure a successful integration and product launch.
* Drive continuous improvement of the implementation process: define and refine the playbook, tooling, and templates that reduce time\-to\-launch and raise the quality bar for every customer experience.
* Represent the customer's voice internally — capture feedback and pain points from implementations and channel them to product, engineering, and support to improve future launches.


**Success in this Role Looks Like:**


* Over the first 90 days, you hit the ground running: shadowing active implementations, learning the moving parts of the process (standard EHR integrations, internal system configurations and project plans), and taking ownership of your first launch.
* Within the first 6 months, you are the customer\-facing lead on multiple concurrent implementations, delivering launches on time and with a high customer satisfaction bar. Customers describe you as trusted, responsive, and a reason they feel confident in Counterpart.
* You have identified at least one meaningful improvement to the implementation process — a template, a workflow change, a handoff refinement — and driven it to adoption across the team.
* Over time, your performance is measured by the consistency, speed, and on\-target delivery of customer implementations, by the strength of the relationships you build with customer stakeholders throughout the process, and by the cumulative improvements you drive into the implementation playbook itself.

### **You should get in touch if:**


* You have 5\-8 years of experience leading technical product implementations in a customer\-facing role, with a strong track record of on\-time, high\-quality launches — and of running multiple implementations in parallel.
* You have 2\+ years of experience in healthcare technology implementations working with provider practices, ideally including EHR standard integrations.
* You have exceptional customer\-facing skills — you build trust quickly with providers, office managers, and clinical leads, communicate clearly under pressure, and manage escalations calmly and directly.
* You are an expert in project management: you set the plan, track it, and drive accountability across internal and customer teams that don't report to you.
* You have strong technical judgment and are comfortable diagnosing potential integration issues and scope creep of the overall project.

#### **Meetings and Events Project Coordinator, Key Accounts**


SALARY RANGE: $65,000\.00 To 75,000\.00 Annually



Location: Fully Remote (EST Schedule)



Reports To: Senior Project Coordinator, Key Accounts Team Lead



Madison is seeking an ambitious, dynamic, and highly organized professional to join our New York–based team as a Meetings and Events Project Coordinator, Key Accounts. This fully remote position requires 3–5 years of experience in meetings and/or events, with demonstrated expertise in data management, registration management, and detailed program execution.



The Project Coordinator works in close collaboration with Project Managers to plan and execute meetings and events of varying scope and scale, including National Meetings, Training Programs, Product Launches, and Incentive Travel programs. The key account supports our client within the pharmaceutical and healthcare sector.



This role is ideal for an experienced meetings professional who thrives in a fast\-paced, data\-driven environment and takes pride in operational excellence, accuracy, and exceptional client service.


#### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **Event Logistics and Cross\-Functional Collaboration:**

* Collaborate with Project Managers, Air Travel Specialists, Technical Specialists, and vendors to align on project objectives.
* Support the event website strategy and Cvent registration builds.
* Coordinate meeting materials in alignment with program timelines, including invitations, confirmations, email communications, pretrip materials, name badges, signage, surveys, and postevent reporting.
* Work with vendors to coordinate amenities, signage, and other programrelated materials.

#### **Registration and Attendee Management:**

* Working alongside Tech Specialists to build, test, and troubleshoot registration platforms and tools.
* Manage the full online registration process, including participant tracking, confirmations, updates, cancellations, and reporting.
* Serve as the primary contact for participant inquiries, managing high email and call volumes with professionalism and efficiency.
* Maintain and oversee all attendee data and reporting throughout the program lifecycle.
* Reconcile data across multiple platforms to ensure accuracy and integrity.

#### **Rooming List Management:**

* Manage and work closely with the hotel to oversee pre/post program extensions.
* Coordinate closely with hotels to ensure alignment on billing and inventory.
* Track changes and cancellations to maintain accurate pickup reporting.

#### **Air Travel Coordination Support:**

* Partnering with internal and external Air Travel Specialists to coordinate travel.
* Process client deviations and track approvals.
* Ensure accurate communication of travelrelated updates to internal teams, vendors and attendees.

#### **KEY COMPETENCIES**

* Ability to thrive in a fastpaced, deadlinedriven environment.
* Detailoriented with strong multitasking, excellent prioritization, and followthrough skills.
* Adaptable, with a keen capacity for proactive problemsolving.
* Demonstrated aptitude for technology and software solutions.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills across all levels of an organization.
* Teamoriented mindset with a collaborative approach.

#### **QUALIFICATIONS**

* 35 years of experience in meetings and events required.
* Advanced Excel proficiency, including VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, Conditional Formatting, and data reconciliation.
* Proven experience with Cvent (preferred) or comparable event/project management platforms.
* Ability to work weekends and outside normal business hours as required.
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally via air, rail, boat, or car as required.


Madison is a proud Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) company. Through our ESOP, employees earn shares in the company over time, creating an added retirement benefit that grows alongside Madison’s success.



We offer a robust benefits package which includes medical, dental, vision, and 401(k) plans. Our offerings also include medical and dependent care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA), life insurance, disability coverage, and pet insurance. Additionally, we provide tuition reimbursement and "You Belong," our employee reward and recognition program.

new_jobs.description:
Description:  


Position Summary  


The Quality Assurance Auditor is responsible for conducting detailed audits of all billing activities and accounts worked within the billing software system. This includes reviewing claim follow\-up, collections efforts, resolution of denials, and special billing projects or programs. The auditor ensures compliance with internal protocols, payer regulations, and industry standards.  


This role plays a critical part in identifying trends, ensuring accuracy, and improving the overall efficiency and effectiveness of the billing and collections process.  


Essential Duties and Responsibilities  


Audit daily work completed by billing staff, including claim submissions, follow\-up activities, and collection efforts.  
Review account documentation, actions taken, and billing outcomes within the billing system to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance.  
Identify errors, discrepancies, and trends that may impact reimbursement, operational efficiency, or regulatory compliance.  
Provide detailed audit findings, feedback, and recommendations to billing staff and leadership to improve performance and accuracy.  
Monitor, address, and audit special projects (e.g., credit card chargebacks and high priority payer follow up) and programs (e.g., AB75\) to ensure adherence to established billing protocols.  
Collaborate with team leads, supervisors, and managers to develop, implement, and refine policies, procedures, and workflows based on audit results.  
Assist with the training and education of staff on documentation standards, payer requirements, billing procedures, and industry best practices.  
Participate in quality assurance initiatives and prepare reports for leadership summarizing audit results, performance trends, and opportunities for improvement.  
Maintain current knowledge of industry regulations, payer policies, and billing software updates applicable to medical billing and accounts receivable.  
Support internal and external audit requests by gathering documentation, performing reviews, and responding to audit inquiries as needed.  
Perform manual tasks within Cross Workflow, including but not limited to AR Support Requests and AR Follow\-Up Requests, while addressing high\-priority emails from Patient Services related to invoices involving legal representation and time\-sensitive deadlines.  
Conduct audits for compliance, as assigned or requested to ensure adherence to company policies, payer guidelines, and regulatory requirements.  


Other Duties  


Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.  


Requirements:  


Knowledge, Skills, \& Abilities  


Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment while maintaining accuracy and focus  
Strong organizational skills to ensure deadlines are met  
Strong knowledge of medical billing and accounts receivable processes, including claim lifecycle, denials, and payer rules.  
Proficient in using billing software and electronic health record (EHR) systems.  
High attention to detail and accuracy in reviewing documentation and financial records.  
Analytical skills with the ability to detect patterns, discrepancies, and areas for improvement.  
Understanding and adhering to HIPAA and other government and healthcare industry regulations.  
Strong written and verbal communication skills to provide constructive feedback and report findings.  
Ability to work independently, manage multiple tasks, and prioritize responsibilities effectively.  
Extensive knowledge of insurance guidelines including Medicare and other government payers, private, self\-insurance, and managed\-care plans.  
Familiarity with auditing techniques and principles within a healthcare revenue cycle setting.  
Knowledge of MS Office including Outlook, Word and Excel  
Excellent verbal and written communication skills  
Excellent attention to detail and time management skills  
Excellent customer service skills.  


Education \& Experience Requirements  


High School Diploma  
Minimum 3\-4 years revenue cycle experience  


Job Type: Full\-time  


Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee discount

* Health savings account
* Life insurance

new_jobs.description:
Company Overview:

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry\-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting\-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth. **Be part of a team that makes a real difference.**
Job Description:
**This is a full\-time, flexible work from home position and** **can be located anywhere in the U.S.** **NY RN license and Compact RN required** **Perks:** Full and comprehensive benefits program, 24 days of paid vacation/holidays in your first year plus sick days, home office equipment including laptop and desktop monitor, Employee Assistance and Referral Program, and hands\-on workers’ compensation case management training.  

Join our compassionate team and help make a positive difference in an injured person’s life. As a Telephonic Case Manager, you will work closely with treating physicians/providers, employers, customers, legal representatives, and the injured/disabled person to create and implement a treatment plan that returns the injured/disabled person back to work appropriately, ensure appropriate and cost\-effective healthcare services, achievement of maximum medical recovery and return to an optimal level of work and functioning. In this role, you will:* Demonstrate knowledge, skills, and competency in the application of case management standards of practice.
* Use advanced knowledge of types of injury, medications, comorbidities, treatment options, treatment alternatives, and knowledge of job duties to advise on a treatment plan.
* Interview disabled persons to assess overall recovery, including whether injuries or conditions are occupational or non\-occupational.
* Collaborate with treating physicians/providers and utilize available resources to help create and implement treatment plans tailored to an individual patient.
* Work with employers and physicians to modify job duties where practical to facilitate early return to work.
* Evaluate and modify case goals based on injured/disabled person’s improvement and treatment effectiveness.
* Independently manage workload, including prioritizing cases and deciding how best to manage cases effectively.
* Complete other duties, such as prepare status updates for submittal to customers, assist in training/orientation of new staff as requested, and other duties as assigned.


Qualifications:
* **Education:** Associates Degree or Bachelor’s Degree in Nursing or related field.
* **Experience:** 2\+ years clinical practice preferred. Workers’ compensation\-related experience preferred.

*

new_jobs.description:
**JOB PURPOSE:**

  

The Call Center Specialist \- IC is responsible for managing a high volume of inbound and outbound calls in a timely and professional manner. This role involves providing exceptional customer service, scheduling appointments, answering inquiries, and assisting patients and their families with accurate information regarding services provided by the healthcare organization. The ideal candidate will have excellent communication skills, empathy, and the ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced environment.
  

  

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Handle incoming and outgoing calls efficiently while maintaining a professional and courteous demeanor.
* Schedule patient appointments accurately using the organization's electronic medical record (EMR) system.
* Respond to patient inquiries regarding services, appointment availability, billing, and other general information.
* Assist patients in rescheduling or canceling appointments while adhering to organizational guidelines.
* Verify and update patient demographic and insurance information during calls.
* Educate patients on healthcare services, office policies, and available resources.
* Document all patient interactions and maintain accurate call records in the appropriate systems.
* Document patient complaints and escalate complex issues to the appropriate department or supervisor.
* Collaborate with clinical staff, administrative teams, and other departments to ensure a seamless patient experience.
* Follow HIPAA regulations to maintain patient confidentiality and data security.
* Achieve performance goals, including call quality, response time, and customer satisfaction metrics.
* Outreach to inquiring callers to keep them informed about their issues/request’s status or resolution.
* Adhere to company and department policies and procedures.
Adheres to all applicable compliance requirements and the Code of Conduct.  
* 

**Weekly Hours:** 40


**Days:** Monday to Friday


**Hours:** 9:00AM \- 6:00PM ET


**Location:** Full time Remote  



  

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

  

**Education:** Associate degree preferred, or equivalent relevant call center years of experience preferred.  



  

**Experience:** One to two (1\-2\) years of experience in customer service, quality, and/or auditing.  



  

**Language:** Must be bilingual in English and one of the following languages: Spanish, Russian, Chinese, Bengali, Korean, Albanian, or a similar language.  



  

**Additional Requirements:**

* The consultant is required to provide valid government\-issued identification as proof of age to verify that they are at least 18 years of age.
* Able to pass a typing test with at least 40 WPM.
* Consultant acknowledges that they have an alternative means of working in the event of a power and/or internet service outage, ensuring they are able to fulfill their job responsibilities without interruption.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment and meet assigned deadlines.
* Excellent organizational skills, accuracy, and attention to detail.
* Ability to operate both independently and collaboratively as required.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, and Outlook.
* Maintain and utilize the necessary equipment, including but not limited to a computer, monitor, headset, and any other tools required to perform the agreed\-upon services.

Successfully complete all mandatory training programs as required by the Organization.

**Physical Requirements**

Individuals must be able to sustain certain physical requirements essential to the job. This includes, but is not limited to:


* **Standing** – Duration of up to 6 hours a day.

In addition, they must be able to speak comfortably and clearly with language motor skills for customers to understand the individual.

new_jobs.title: Sr. Enablement Partner
new_jobs.description:
**About us**  

HighLevel is an AI\-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150\+ countries, fueling community\-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.  

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.  

Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2\.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250\+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long\-term scalability.  

  

**Our people**  

With over 2,000 team members across 10\+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote\-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.  

  

**Our impact**  

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1\.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.  

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts
**Who You Are:**


* You have worked inside an affiliate, partner, or channel program — not just adjacent to one. You understand how affiliates think, what motivates them, and what causes them to disengage.
* You are a builder and a coach first. You get energy from watching a manager's conversation quality improve week over week — not from presenting to executives
* You write playbooks from scratch, design onboarding sequences, and build call frameworks that real people actually use.
* You are data\-aware. You can read an Olive AI dashboard, spot a no\-show pattern, and connect it to a coaching intervention.
* You are willing to travel and show up in person. This role requires event attendance, in\-person affiliate relationship building, and on\-site team sessions.
* You have an existing network in the affiliate, partner, or digital marketing ecosystem. You know people. You bring contacts.

**What You’ll Be Doing:**



HighLevel's affiliate channel is one of the most important growth levers in the business, servicing thousands of affiliate partners, a top\-performing endorsed tier, and a team of Affiliate Managers working daily to move partners from sign\-up to their first trial and beyond.



We are building the enablement infrastructure to match the scale of this channel. The Affiliate Enablement Manager will be the first dedicated resource for the affiliate org who is leveraging their extensive enablement background to equip our internal team first, then extend that excellence to the affiliate experience.



This is a build role. You will be creating the foundation of knowledge and growth for the entire affiliate organization from the ground\-up while collaborating with senior affiliate leadership. If you thrive in fast\-moving environments, have a background in partnerships, affiliate programs, or channel sales enablement, and believe that great coaching and onboarding are revenue levers, not overhead — this role is for you.



You will:


* Own onboarding for every new affiliate manager joining the affiliate team, resulting in time\-to\-first\-activation results amongst growing affiliate managers and “exams” to ensure proficiency is maintained across the entire organization
* Build a structured learning path: what does an affiliate manager need to know in their first 7 days, 30 days, and 90 days? Own the content, the sequence, and the checkpoints.
* Own a continuous, always\-on enablement cadence for existing AFMs — not just new hires — so product knowledge and call quality stay current as the team and the platform both grow.
* Create and maintain a centralized internal resource hub — an always\-current repository of playbooks, SOPs, and tools that every AFM can access in seconds.
* Design and own the structured onboarding experience for all new affiliates outside the endorsed tier
* Build and maintain the product knowledge baseline, establishing what a “qualified affiliate manager” knows about the product, the program, and strategies about our top affiliates
* Collaborate with Affiliate Partner individuals to build lifecycle communication sequences (email, SMS, in\-app) that guide new affiliates from sign\-up through first trial
* Work cross\-functionally to ensure that the process for new affiliates is constantly being optimized for broader team goals
* Provide reports for senior leadership, finance, revenue operations, and other stakeholders as needed
* Attend affiliate industry events, conferences, and meetups — representing GHL and building direct relationships with existing and prospective affiliate partners.

**Our mission:**



To make recurring work fun, fast, and faultless for teams everywhere.


**Our culture:**



Process Street was founded on a strong belief in the work\-life benefits of a healthy, collaborative remote culture. We value flexibility because many of us are parents, travelers, or just creatives who aren't inspired by the construct of a mundane 9\-to\-5\. Spread across 9 different time zones, we communicate asynchronously, work autonomously, and take real ownership of our work. We know human connections are what make teams strong, so we regularly do coffee chats, game\-playing, story\-telling, and more, to build strong relationships.



If you’re entrepreneurial and seek an environment that values impact, ownership, and flexibility we look forward to meeting you!


**Where and when you’ll work**



This is a fully remote role open to candidates **based outside of the United States**. Because you’ll be supporting US\-based customers, you’ll work US business hours \- primarily Pacific Time (PT) \- with the flexibility to support customers across PT, MT, and CT.


**The Opportunity**



This is an early\-career Customer Success role, and a great way to grow into the craft alongside an experienced team. You don’t need to have experience as a CSM before, but you do need to genuinely love working with people, solving problems, and a real curiosity about how people and companies operate.



Customer Success sits at the heart of Process Street because our customers tell us where to go. You'll be one of the people closest to them, helping them get real value from the product and grow with us over time. Some customers start small and grow into huge, multi\-departmental rollouts, and you'll be a central player in making that happen. No two customers look the same, and that's the fun part.

 **What You’ll Do**


* Build trusted relationships with customers, learning how each one works and where they want to go.
* Plan and guide new customers through implementation, onboarding, and training.
* Support existing customers by answering questions, highlighting new features, and running Quarterly Business Reviews.
* Contribute to support systems, such as in\-product guides, webinars, and our Help Center.
* Work closely with other departments to bring the customer voice into the product roadmap and strategy.
* Identify expansion and referral opportunities through the relationships you build and think creatively about how to act on them.
* Track the numbers that matter, like churn, time to first value, and net promoter score.
* Experiment with new strategies, tools, and AI to help customers (and yourself) to work smarter.
* Always keep our value of Delighting Customers top of mind.

* **You bring real customer experience!** You’ve worked directly with customers or clients before and loved it.

As the most trusted global leader in data\-first contract lifecycle management (CLM) software, Agiloft helps organizations manage the end\-to\-end process of proposing, negotiating, signing, and leveraging contracts using our flexible Data\-first Agreement Platform (DAP). With contract data as the foundation, customers quickly and collaboratively reach agreement and leverage contract visibility to thrive with competitive advantage. Employing powerful, pragmatic artificial intelligence as a legal force multiplier, and robust integration capabilities as a data liberator, organizations around the world trust Agiloft’s certified implementers to deliver connected, intelligent, and autonomous solutions across the entire contract lifecycle.  

Top analysts like Gartner, Forrester, and IDC agree, all showing Agiloft as a leader in the CLM space. Our no code platform is easily managed and administered by business users, which is why Agiloft is the contract you keep: nearly a full 100% of new customers are satisfied with their initial implementations, and some 97% of customers renew every year. Ours is a growing, vibrant, successful company that is at the forefront of a market that is becoming a must\-have for all organizations.  

We believe that the way to build the strongest, most vibrant place to work is to bring in individuals from all walks of life, and to support them in bringing their authentic selves to their day, every day. Our working philosophy is that “EX \= CX”: when employee experience is excellent, so is customer experience. We support multiple Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), and offer a working environment that supports healthy work/life balance, including floating holidays and a quarterly, no\-questions\-asked wellness day.### **Position Overview**



Agiloft is seeking a collaborative, motivated, and results\-driven professional to join our dynamic Account Management team. As a Strategic Account Manager, you will play a critical role in driving executive alignment, adoption, expansion, retention, and long\-term value across our Strategic customer base.



In this role, you will act as a strategic advisor to senior and C\-level stakeholders, helping customers leverage Agiloft’s AI\-enhanced Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platform across SaaS subscriptions and token\-based AI consumption to transform contracting operations, mitigate risk, improve compliance, govern consumption, and unlock enterprise\-wide insights.



This position is ideal for a seasoned strategic\-account seller who thrives in complex global environments, excels at executive engagement, and drives durable growth through multi\-year account strategy, rigorous sales execution, commercial creativity, and fluency across SaaS and consumption\-based models.

* **Account Expansion \& Revenue Growth**
	+ Develop and execute multi\-year strategic account strategies to drive executive alignment, adoption, expansion ARR, responsible consumption growth, retention, and long\-term value creation
	+ Identify, qualify, and close complex upsell, cross\-sell, enterprise\-wide standardization, and token\-consumption opportunities across strategic organizations
	+ Drive expansion across business units, departments, subsidiaries, regions, and affiliated entities within the enterprise family tree
	+ Own renewal and expansion strategy, partnering closely with Customer Success to ensure account health and risk mitigation, long\-term client retention, executive value realization, SaaS revenue stability, and governed consumption growth
	+ Position Agiloft as a strategic enterprise platform, clearly articulating differentiated value including AI\-driven capabilities, enterprise standardization, SaaS subscription value, and token\-consumption economics
* **Client Relationship Management**
	+ Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior leaders, C\-level executives, economic buyers, and cross\-functional transformation sponsors across legal, procurement, finance, IT, and operations
	
	Act as a strategic advisor by aligning Agiloft’s capabilities to enterprise\-wide business initiatives, operating priorities, risk programs, and transformation agendas  
	+ 
	Partner cross\-functionally with Sales Leadership, Customer Success, Solution Consulting, Product, and Professional Services  
	+ 
	+ Lead executive business reviews focused on business outcomes, adoption, consumption governance, strategic alignment, and enterprise\-wide value realization
* **Sales Strategy and Execution**
	+ Leverage account intelligence, customer insights, token\-consumption trends, executive priorities, and forecasting tools (e.g., Clari / SalesLoft) to identify expansion opportunities, forecast accurately, and manage complex strategic account pipeline health
	+ Apply the MEDDPICC sales methodology across all expansion and renewal motions to qualify opportunities, guide deal strategy, and drive predictable outcomes, including economic buyer alignment, decision process, paper process, and champion validation
	+ Lead complex strategic expansion opportunities from identification through close, including multi\-threaded executive alignment and cross\-functional orchestration of internal resources to advance strategic account objectives
	+ Develop and execute close plans aligned to MEDDPICC criteria, including economic buyer alignment and competitive positioning
	+ Maintain accurate records of account activities, renewal risks, expansion opportunities, consumption signals, and sales forecasts
	+ Provide regular executive\-level updates to sales leadership on account strategy, renewal posture, expansion path, consumption trends, risk, and forecast accuracy
* **Customer Insights \& Collaboration**
	+ Serve as the voice of strategic customers internally, providing executive\-level feedback to influence product direction, AI roadmap, monetization packaging, implementation motions, and go\-to\-market strategy

At Mission Underwriters, we provide the capital, issuing paper, and reinsurance access you need to launch your own Program Administrator (PA) business quickly and efficiently. We offer non\-recourse capital for qualified underwriters, giving you a manageable risk profile with potential equity upside. By taking care of administrative complexities like compliance, risk management, accounting, and HR, we free you to focus on what you do best—underwriting and distribution. Our turnkey platform gets you into the market in just a few months, minimizing disruption to your key relationships. With access to our network of highly rated issuing carriers and reinsurance partners, you can secure coverage with less stress and uncertainty. Built from the ground up, our purpose\-driven technology simplifies workflows, enhances responsiveness, and eliminates the burden of outdated legacy systems.

* Remote First Work Environment (US Based)
* Medical, Dental, Vision
* 401K, 401K Match

* Unaccrued Paid Time Off
* 11 Paid Holidays
* Employee Discounts

* Implement capabilities across TO\-relevant ServiceNow areas such as ITSM, ITOM/Discovery, CMDB/CSDM, IntegrationHub, SPM, Performance Analytics, App Engine, and other approved products as assigned.
